720: Adam harishon, beshaata chivya deata veitpatta al yedoy, yachil chivya leh. may tama. begin dela hava tukepa leadam harishon, vead kean la ityylid man dehava tukepa dileh. umanno tukepa deadam harishon. da shet, dehava bediyyukena deadam harishon mammash, dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyoled bidmuto ketztzalmo vyyikra et shemo shet. may bidmuto ketztzalmo. dehava mahul. vechad ata memana deesav legabbe deyaakov, kevar ityelid tukepa deyaakov, deihu yosef. vezehu uveono sara et elohim. (74 kan matzati)
Hay kala deitteta, deyachla kala dechivya leachada bah, kechalba bechalbeta, man ihu.
Kema deattun amrin. ella hahu koach dehahu rucha, veal da, terin zimnin ketiv behay kera, veen lahem menachem. chad millilit chayyayvta, vechad mehahu rucha.
I sava, hasheta it lach rechimin, veat mishtae, keman dela chamit innun maggiche kerava, ha kullehu bishlama immach. hasheta mikkan ulehala, la ade minnay mane kerava bedil leadkera shemi.

Hahu chattat rovetz, kaim al pitcha kechalba. bezimna dekala batrayyta, deyahivat itteta, nafik, ihu dalig meal pitcha veitavar mittamman, veazil avatrah. may tama. begin dekudesha berich hu shadar chad maftecha dileh, vekala parcha, umaftecha atya, vechivya azal batar kala dehu nafik lealma, vead tura devitna azil, umechashkesha, ad iddan deitnekiat, mehahu zuhama, dinshichin dechivya bisha. vekudesha berich hu, mesabbev sivuvin, veavid ovadin kadka yeot.

Vechol da, begin dehahu beten itdachya. ha vadday, itdachya mehahu beten, velet leh chulaka, veitdache mibbeten diltatta, dishar neshin dealma deaf al gav deavid tzaar la ityeyhiv leh reshu leshalletaa beh. uman beten ityeyhiv leh, veihu shalit aleh. hahu beten desota, dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:27) vetzavta vitnah, begin dehay beten, avid beh nukemin liruteh, vehay beten dileh ihu, vekudesha berich hu yahiv leh begin dela itdache mikkolla. hasheta rechimin dili, atzitu. la chamena lechu, umallilna lechu. (Kohelet 1:8) kol haddevarim yegeim, la yachil inish lemallela, afillu millin deorayyta yegeim innun.

Ketiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vayyeavek ish immo, uchetiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho. vehahu yarech deravavch miyyaakov. vehahu yarech bachalishu dileh (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet, 144 amud alef) ad deata shemuel. may bachalishu dela mashich nevua. kad ata shemuel, natal hahu yarech, vesalkeh mehahu atar, vechataf leh minneh, umehahu zimna itade minneh, vela hava leh chulaka bikdusha kelal.

Kudesha berich hu la kafach, vela dache leh mikkolla, begin denatal shemuel yarech dileh, ella yahiv leh chulaka chada. may ihi. yahiv leh hahu yarech uveten desota, cholaf hahu yarech uveten, deade minneh. veal da tarvavyyhu yahiv leh kudesha berich hu, lemehve atra dekudsha panuy mikkol saavuta.

Velanpil yarech. mahu velanpil, venafla yerechah velatzbot, vetzavta yerechah mibbae leh. ella, keman deashde garma lechalba, veamar leh, tol hay lechulakach. umikkolla la avish kameh, ella degazlu (sefer acher deappiku) minneh yarech, begin deihu yaga velae aleh, veravavch leh veappiku leh minneh. veal da, kudesha berich hu appil leh, garma da desota, veappik leh kidkamran, uveda ihu ravvi vechadde.

Kol innun retichin vesiyyayta dileh, baan tadir yarech, veazle bechisufa avatreh. uvegin da, (112 amud bet) hane barchi derabbanan deshalhe, min da ihu. dechol kissufa dilhon, batar yarech ihu, vechol shekken yarech derabbanan, vechol milla ahdar leatreh, vekudesha berich hu la gara kelum, mikkol ma deitzterich, vela baa deyikrav likdusha, bar immeh veadveh chulakeh veachasanteh. kema deavid kudesha berich hu leella, hachi avde yisrael letatta, vehachi itzterich lemebad, vehachi tanenan, asir leh leyisrael, lemelaf orayyta leovde kochavim umazzalot, dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:20) maggid devarav leyaakov vegomer, lo asa chen lechol goy vegomer.
Veal da dache leh yaakov, vedache leh shemuel, dela yehe leh chulaka
721: Bikdusha. uvegin da, kol netiru devavu leyisrael, al da ihu. lechalba dechatif ofa dachya min shoka, veayyte leh, vead la ittevar, ata chad bar nash vechatfa minneh, levatar yahiv leh chad garma gerira bela toalta.

Kacha lesaro shel esav, appiku leh mehahu beten, chatifu minneh hahu yarech. levatar yahavu leh garma chad, hahu beten vehahu yarech desota, vela ochora. ha garma, deka yahavu leh lechulakeh veadveh, vearav leh. ubbegin kach, kol dinin dekudesha berich hu dinin dikshot innun, uveni nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin lekudesha berich hu. vechullehu beorach keshot. hi astiat garmah mibbalah, kema deat amer (Mishlei 2:17) haozevet alluf neureha vegomer, uf hachi itteta, kegavvna dilah beara.

Ta chaze, man deashkach chavra kevavteh, deavid keovadoy bealma, rachim leh, veitdabbak bahadeh, veavid immeh tivu. aval sitra ochora lav hachi, kevan deashkach man deshavak sitra dikdusha dekudesha berich hu, veavid keovadoy, veitdabbak bah, keden baya leshetzaa uleappaka leh mealma. hay itteta, avdat keovadaha, veitdabbekat bah, chazi ma deavdat bah, vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah. kudesha berich hu lav hachi, man deshavik lesitra ochora, veitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu, keden rachim leh, veavid leh kol tivu dealma. hasheta sava atkin garmich, deha chivya azil leh, uvaa leitgara bahadach, vela yachil.

Patach veamar (Kohelet 1:3) ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh, vechi la ata shelomo ella leolfa milla da. illu amar (sefer acher vechi ma ata shelomo malka leallafa bemilla da vetu ellu amar) baamalo sheyyaamol yeot, deha ishtear amal, deit beh yitron. ella kevan dichtiv bechol amalo, ha kelala decholla, dela ishtear kelum deit beh yitron.

Ella, lav lechol adam amar shelomo milla da, ella adam it bealma, deihu mishtaddel tadir bevish uleavashsha, vela ishtaddal betav afillu riga chada. veal da ketiv amalo, vela ketiv yegio. amalo: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 7:17) yashuv amalo verosho. (Bamidbar 23:21) velo raa amal beyisrael. yegio: kema deat amer (Tehillim 128:2) yegia kappecha ki tochel vegomer. uchetiv (Bereshit 31:42) veet yegia kappay raa elohim. aval amalo, ketiv, (Tehillim 10:14) amal vachaas. ishtaddeluteh hu tadir levish, veal da ihu tachat hashshamesh.

Beshaata dehay adam ishtaddal bevish, al hay ketiv, (Iyov 18:19) lo nin lo velo neched beammo vegomer, deha kudesha berich hu bae, dela yabid toladin, deilmale yabed toladin, hava metashtesha alma. veal da ketiv, ma yitron laadam bechol amalo. uman dela yishtaddal lemebad toladin, itdabbak behay sitra deadam bisha veal techot gadpoy.

Rut amra, (Rut 3:9) ufarasta chenafecha al amatcha, begin leizdavvevga bahadeh detzaddik, lemebad toladin, vekudesha berich hu paris gadpoy al bar nash, begin leappasha bealma. leman dela bae lemebad toladin, begappo yavo, begappo dehahu bish, deihu azil ariri, kechivya da, (95 amud alef) deazil yechiday. begappo yetze, (kema deat amar hasheta) ihu dela ishtaddal lemebad toladin, ha ittemar kol ma deitzterich. (sefer acher ta chaze, deit leahaddera sava, bemillin kadmain)

Riv deavad kudesha berich hu, ha ittemar, riv: dichtiv, (Micha 6:1) kum riv et heharim. may ihu. ella, innun turin diltatta. amay riv da. begin divhu talya, kol chova deavdin yisrael, legabbe avuhon devishmayya. may taama. begin deyisrael havo yadin shimmusha dechol malachin illain devishmayya, vela anis lehu, afillu shema dechad minnayyhu, vechol shimmusha dilhon.

Uvitren sitrin have taan avatrayyhu. chad, dahavo yadin leamshacha chela dilhon, dekochavayya umazzale beara. vechad, dahavo yade leumaa lon, bechol ma deitzterichu. veal da baa kudesha berich hu lemebad behu riv vedina. vechevan dibbehon leheve riv vedina, kol shilshula nafal deha la yeheve beh toalta. uvegin kach, kum riv vegomer. vetishmana haggevaot kolecha.
722: Man givot. illen innun immahot, (109 amud bet, 189 amud bet) dargin deikrun (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha vegomer, uvegin kach vetishmana haggevaot kolecha. dehachi havo avde yisrael, ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain. ta chaze, deit leahaddera sava, bemillin kadmain,

Dehachi havo avde yisrael, ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain yarech deka amaran, saggi atkifu lon yisrael, behahu yarech. mardechay hava achme lehahu rasha dehaman hahu yarech dileh, veal da hava ragiz, milla deitchaze leh, veihu argiz leh bahadeh. chamu chavrayyay, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:15) vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot vegomer. beillen levushin dileh, gazal dileh, veappik leh mikkol birkan dileh, umibbechiruta.

Uvegin kach, ila deka ashkachu retichin dileh, lerabbanan, ihu dechufeya dilhon lemane derabbanan tadir. (111) leyarchin dilhon. ulemanin dilhon. veillen teren millin distar achara havo, vechol da begin degazlu lon minneh. let lehu ila ella lerabbanan. uvegin kach, hane mani derabbanan deka balu mechufeya dilhon ihu, vehani barchi deshalhe, minnayyhu hu vadday. umiddilhon havo, uminnehon natle ila, umimma dahavo minnayyhu. baan lerabbanan, deinnun kelala dehahu yoshev ohalim, veal da let ila bela ila, veal da let milla, bela dina, vechol milla tav leatreh.

Shelomo amar, (Kohelet 4:1) veshavti ani vaere et kol haashukim asher naasim tachat hashshamesh vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem umiyyad oshkehem koach veen lahem menachem. hay kera armizna beh, (111 amud bet) veittemar. aval shavti ani, vechi mean atar tav shelomo. i nima, levatar deamar milla da, tav kemilkaddemin, veamar milla ochora, yeot aval shavti vaere (Vayikra 233 amud alef).

Tamman tanenan, bechol yoma hava akdim shelomo betzafra, vahave shavve anpoy listar mizrach, vechame ma dechame, ulevatar tav listar darom, vechame ma dechame vehadar tav listar tzafon, vekaim tamman. maich enoy vezakif resheh.

Behay shaata, ha ammuda deeshsha veammuda daanana, havo atyayn, veal hahu ammuda daanana, hava ate nishra chada. vehahu nishra hu ravreva vetakkif, vechen hava ate, gadpa yemina, al gabbe ammuda deeshsha, vegufa vegadpa semala, al gabbe ammuda daanana. vehahu nishra havi mayyte teren tarfin befumaha, ata ammuda daanana, veammuda deeshsha, vehahu nishra alayyhu, vesagdin lekameh deshlomo malka.

Ata nishra, umaich lekameh, veyahiv leh innun tarfin, natil lon shelomo malka, vahava meriach behu, vahava yada behon siman, veamar da ihu denofel, veda ihu digluy enayim. beshaata ditren tarfin havo, hava yada detarvavyyhu, (balak Rosh Chodesh amud alef) nofel ugeluy enayim baan leodaa leh millin.

Ma avid, chatim kurseyeh begushepanka, dehava chakik beh shema kaddisha. veihu natil izka dechakik aleh shema kaddisha, vesalik leigra, verachiv al hahu nishra, veazil leh. vehahu nishra, hava mistallak, lerum ananin, uvechol atar deihu avar, hava itchashach nehora. chakkime dahavo behahu atar deitchashach nehora, havo yade, vahavu amre, shelomo malka ha azil, veabar hacha, vela yade lean atar hava azil. tippeshin dahavo tamman, havo amre, ananin havo innun, deka azle vechashich alma.

Gava nishra bahadeh, ufarach arba mea parsin, ad demata leture chashoch. vetamman ihu tarmud bammidbar beharim, veihu nachit tamman. zakif resheh, vechame tura chashoch, vahava yada tamman kol ma deitzterich. vahava yada detamman yeul. hava rachiv al nishra kemillekadmin, vetas veal lego turin, ad hahu atar dezeta taman, kara bechela veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:11) Adonai rama yadcha bal yechozayun vegomer.

Al tamman, ad dekariv lehahu atar, shavve izka kamayyhu, vekariv, vetamman hava yada kol ma devae meinnun chachmetan nucherain, devae leminda. kevan dahavo amrin leh kol ma devae, keden hava rachiv al hahu
723: Nishra, vetav leatreh. kevan dehava yativ al kuresyeh, ityayshshav bedateh vahava memallel bedateh millin dechachmeta yakkira. behahi shaata hava amar, veshavti ani vaere, shavti vadday mehahu archa, shavti mehahi chachmeta, veityeyshavit belibbay uvedatay. ucheden vaere et kol haashukim. vechi zeirin innun bealma deihu amar et kol haashukim

(Nusach acher salleka datach dechol ashikin dahavo bealma, hava chame shelomo malka.) ella, may ashukim illen dehu amar. innun yenokin demetin betukefa deimmehon, deka ashukim mikkamma sitrin, ashukim baatar illaa dilella, vaashukim letatta. veha chavrayyay ittearu, vehachi hu, aval saggiin innun. kum sava, ittear bechelach. sava ema milach, devadday bela dechilu tema.
Let ashuk keinnun ashukim, dehava ihu ashik bekadmita, o mittelata leochora, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 20:Adonai) poked avon avot al banim veal bene vanim al shilleshim veal ribbeim.

Hecha hava ashik. shelomo malka tzavavch veamar (Mishlei 28:17) adam ashuk bedam nafesh ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo. kevan dehu ashuk, bedam nefesh, hu, o beno, o ben beno, yehon ashukin betikla, dichtiv ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo. ad hahu bor rak yanus meatar kaddisha, veal yitmechu bo behay alma. kevan deihu ashuk bedam nefesh, ihu, o zareh, lehevo ashukim mehahu sitra ochora.

It ashuk, mishshear ashukim, kema deat amer (Vayikra 19:13) lo taashok et reacha. ihu avar veashak, ihu ashuk bivnoy, mehahu sitra ochora. ubbegin kach amar, et kol haashukim. amar shelomo, kaimna bechol innun ashukim, bechol sitrin daashak.
Vaamay innun ashukim. asher naasu tachat hashshamesh. asher naasu, asher garu mibbae leh, may asher naasu. i asiyyay ihi lishvacha, lav asiyyay dilhon ella leella min shimsha.

Aval vadday naasu. hech naasu. ella kevan deashukim meruchehon tamman, amay atyayn lehay alma. ella ruchin vadday naasu, itavidu beruchin uvegufa behay alma, kevan deishtachlal gufa dilhon, veitavid hahu rucha begufa zach venaki bela lichlucha dechovin, behay alma, keden itashak gufa, kema deitashak rucha. vehay ihu gufa, deithane beh yattir mikkolla. vaashukin acharanin it, bechamma zinin meruchin tamman, vela naasu begufin. aval illen, innun ashukim asher naasu.

It acharanin, asher naasu, veatrachu bene nasha lemarehon. uman ihu. man deashik itteta dechavreh bitmiru, o beitgalleyay. vehahu valda deityelid minnayyhu, ashuk ihu, bela reuta demarihon, vela yada balah deitteta, innun ovadin ashukin innun, veatrachu lekudesha berich hu lemebad lon gufa, uletzayyeyra lon tzura, illen ashukim asher naasu. asher naasu vadday gufin dilhon, al karcha. begin kach, shelomo malka amar, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim, bechol zine ashukim kaimna, innun asher naasu veitavidu baasiyyay.

Kema dehane (davar achar ihu baarla, eno rabbi veavid ulevatar ashkin leh minna hachi) innun ashukin, dechvar naasu bearla rabbe venatil vegadil gufa, veavid leh, ulevatar ashkin lon minneh, venatlin lon, hare ashukim asher naasu, veal kolla kaim shelomo malka veamar, kaimna al kol haashukim asher naasu.

Vehinne dimat haashukim, kolla oshdin dimin, im taana kame kudesha berich hu. hane oshdin dimin, deha arla rabbe lon, vegadil lon, ad 13 shenin, ulevatar ashkin lon mearla, venatil lon kudesha berich hu, ha lach ashukin asher naasu kevar.

Avar avera katlin leh. lon it taana, uzeminin lomar, mare dealma, tinok bar yomeh dechav, dayynin leh dina. ana bar yomeh havena, deha (98 amud bet) mehahu yoma kare leh kudesha berich hu ben, dichtiv (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani
724: Hayyom yelidticha, mareh dealma, yelid bar yoma, dina avdin leh, hare dimat innun haashukim veen lahem menachem.

Veit ashuk acher, hahu ashuk deikre mamzer, kad nafak mealma, miyyad mafrishin leh mikkehillata deamma kaddisha. hahu mamzer, anya miskena, oshid dimin kame kudesha berich hu, veatin kameh, mareh dealma, i avahatay chavu, ana ma chova avidna, ha ovaday, mittakkenan lekammach havo, vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem. vechen lechol innun ashukim, it lon taana kame kudesha berich hu, umehahi taana let lon menachem, velet deyativ milla al libbehon.

Uma deamar (et kol haashukim) vehinni dimat haashukim, illen innun demetin betukefa deimmehon, illen avdin leoshada dimin, lechol bene alma, begin delet dimin denafke millibba, kehane dimin, dechol beni alma tavvhin veamrin, dinin dekudesha berich hu keshot innun, veal orach keshot azle. hani miskene yenuke dela chavu, amay mitu. an dina dikshot, deavid mare alma. i bechove avahathon istalleke mealma, amay. vadday en lahem menachem.

Tu, vehinne dimat haashukim, hahu dima dilhon behahu alma, deka meginnin al chayyaya. ditnan atar it mittakna lon behahu alma, deafillu tzaddikim gemurim la yachlin lekayyeyma taman, vekudesha berich hu rachim lon, veitdabbak behu, veatkin behu, (96 amud bet) metivta illaa dileh. vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 8:3) mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz. umay toalta avdin tamman, vaamay sallekin tamman. dichtiv, (Tehillim 8:3) lemaan tzorrecha lehashebit oyev umitnakkem. vechen it atar ochora levaale tiyyuveta. (tachzor leel daf 106 tanenan let milla)

Tanenan, asara devarim itberiu beerev shabbat kulei. hakketav vehammichtav vehalluchot. dichtiv vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu. may irya middehachi deerev shabbat hava, vedilma elef shenin levatar, o beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay. ella, vadday hachi hu deberev shabbat hava. ta chaze, bechol ovada divreshit, la ittemar shem male, ella elohim, elohim, bechol ma deitbere. vechullehu shem elohim, ad dechol ovada ishtachlal beerev shabbat. middeishtachlalu kol ovada, ikre Adonai elohim, shem male.

Veaf al gav divshem elohim itbere kolla, la ishtachlal baasiyya, kol ma deitbere, ad erev shabbat. behahi shaata ishtachlal kolla baasiyya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) melachto asher asa. mikkol melachto asher asa. vekayyeyma bemaase. veal da ketiv, vehalluchot maase elohim, kad ishtachlal alma, beshem elohim bemaase, vela levatar, dichtiv Adonai elohim uveda ishtachlal alma, vekayyeyma al kiumeh.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata detavar moshe halluchot, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:19) vayshabber otam tachat hahar. tzaf okyaynus meatreh, vesalik leshattefa alma. chama moshe deokyaynus salik legabbayyhu, vahava bae leshattefa alma, miyyad vayyikkach et haegel asher asho vayyisrof oto baesh vegomer, vayyizer al peni hammayim. kam moshe al me okyaynus veamar, mayya mayya ma attun baan. amru vechi itkayyaym alma ella beorayyta deluchot, veal orayyta deshakru bah yisrael (davar acher vaavadu egla dedahava, anan baan leshattefa alma.)

Miyyad amar lon, ha kol ma deavdu bechova deegla, ha masir lechon, vela day kol innun alfin denaflu minnayyhu, miyyad vayyizer al peni hammayim. la havo mishtachche mayya, ad denatil mayya minnayyhu veashke lon, miyyad ishteka okyaynus beatreh.

Deha behahu midbar la havo mayya, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:Adonai) lo mekom zera vegomer. umayim ayin lishtot. vei tema, levera demiryam armi leh. chas veshalom, detamman shade moshe duchrana bisha da lemishte levatar. vetu, dead kan la hava lehu bera, ad deatu lemidbar mattana, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim vegomer. umimmidbar mattana. mittamman yartu bera. ketiv hacha al pene hammayim, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 1:2) al peni tehom.
Charut al halluchot, may charut al halluchot. hachi ukemuha, cherut mimmalach hammavet, cherut mishshibud malchiyyot,
725: Cherut mikkolla, hachi hu. umay charut. gushepanka dealma deate, deveh hava cherut, bechol mine cherut. veilmale la ittebaru, kol ma deata lealma levatar, la ata, vahavu yisrael diyyukena demalachin illain dilella. veal da achriz kera veamar, vehalluchot maase elohim vegomer, la tema dilvatar dealma ishtachlal, veadkar shem male havo, ella beshaata deishtachlal beshem elohim, ad la yeul shabbat.

Hemma, may hemma. hippuch 50 havo. mitteren sitrin havo. chada beovada, vachada decherut leela, rashim leella lenatra lecholla. veal da 50. vehammichtav michtav elohim hu, eshsha uchama al gabbe eshsha chivvavra. michtav elohim hu, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu. charut kema deittemar, deha yovel kare charut, veavid cherut lechol almin.

Ad kan chavrayyay. mikkan vehala tindeun, deha sitra bisha, la shalta alayychu vaana yeva sava, kaimna kamayychu, leitteara millin illen, kamu innun, keman deittear mishshenateh, veishtetachu kameh, vela havo yachlin lemallela. levatar shaata bachu.

Uvegin da, al halachot acharanin ittemar, (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot asu chayil. al halacha dilach ittemar, veat alit al kullana. deitgabbart al kullehu, bigvura. (Shoftim 6:12) Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil. atkin (sefer acher ittakfat) bach, veashlim binyayna demalka, veihu bane binyayneh al pumach, veal yedach, zakkaa chulakach.

Patach raya mehemana veamar, (Bereshit 48:16) hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra, deihi shechinta, deittemar bah, (Shemot 14:19) vayyissa malach haelohim. yevarech lechu bealma deate. veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz, bealma den. lemeheve shultanutechon bitren almin, deattun chayyin. deman deihu mealma da, chay itkere. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah. chayyim tamman, chayyim hacha.

Ma delav hachi, man deihu melubbash beillen kelifin, deor uvasar vaatzamot vegidim degufa shefela, derucha hu mit tamman. ma meta, la chame vela shama vela memallel velet leh tenua bechol evarin dileh. hachi rucha, la chaza dilel minnih. deittemar beorayyta alayyhu, da ma lemala mimmach, ayin roe veozen shomaat, vechol maasecha besefer nichtavim.

Dechamma malachin azlin immeh, deittemar behon, (Tehillim 91:11) ki malachav yetzavve lach. velet leh reshu behay gufa, leistakkela behon, ulemishma bekalehon, deinnun chivan deeshsha, (81 amud bet) memallelan umekaddeshan umevarchan umeyachadan lekudesha berich hu, im yisrael kachada. kol shekken lishchinta, deihi alayyhu. kol shekken kudesha berich hu deihu leella min shechinteh, devah mekabbel tzelotin deyisrael.

Uvegin chovin, havo mitlabbeshin beillen kelifin. kegavvna deadam, dechove avahathon bidehon. vehay ihu deukemuha mare matnitin, kesheochazin maase avotehem bidehem. uvegin illen kelifin dechovin, amar kera, (Yeshayahu 59:2) ki im avonotechem hayu mavdilim benechem leven elohechem. uvegin illen kelifin, kudesha berich hu mitkasya bechamma gadpin. deittemar behon, (Yeshayahu 6:2) bishtayim yechasse panav uvishtayim yechasse raglav vegomer.

Leatid lavo, (Yeshayahu 30:20) velo yikkanif od morecha vehayu enecha root et morecha. deattun behay alma, delet lechon kelifin veorin, it lechon reshu leistakkela bivni alma, uvene alma (sefer acher let) it lon reshu leistakkela bechu. uvegin da, alayychu ittemar deattun chayyin, vealma dilchon, olam hachayyim. aval alma shefala, da olam hammetim, dechol elahut deumin dealma, mibbalade Adonai, kullehon metim.

Amar leh rabbi shimon, (butzina kaddisha) (nusach acher raya 146) im kol da, deant la yachil leistakkela bivne alma deate beayynin, vela bemalachayya, kol shekken bekudesha berich hu uvishchinteh, aval been hassechel delibbach, at chazi becholla bivne alma deate, uvemalachin uvekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. desacharin lach. uvegin da amar shelomo, dichtiv beh (Melachim 1 Adonai:11) vayyechkam mikkol haadam, (Kohelet 1:16) velibbi raa harebe chachma vadaat.

Aval bannevua, let lechon reshu leistakkela beh (kol shekken) navi been hassechel, ella beayynin, deihi mare vechezyon deayynin, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:6) bammara elav etvadda. veod bechezyon layla, mare bimama, chezyon belelya, vecholla beayynin, vela been hassechel delibba. veayynin innun tere sarsure delibba, umishshammashin dileh. veihu malka benayyhu (legabbayyhu), uvegin da, chacham adif minnavi. vehachi hu teren udenin, teren shammashe delibba.

Uvegin da ukemuha rabbanan, hallev roe, vehallev shomea. velo od, ella deittemar ballev, hallev mevin, hallev yodea. (Shemot 31:6) uvelev kol chacham lev natatti chachma. hare chachma utevuna vadaat belibba. dibbehon itavidu shemayya veara, utehomin. uvehon itavid mashkena,
731: Hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 31:3) vaamalle oto ruach elohim bechachma bitvuna uvedaat. ma delet kule hay beayynin.

Veraya mehemana, man dechule hay belibbeh, yattir chazi min navi, kol shekken machashavta dilach. delet lah sof, uvah tistakkal, behahu, delet beh sof, ma dela hava lach reshu bekadmita leistakkela beayynin. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau.

Illen tippeshe delibba, innun metin, vesumin beillen kelifin. aval legabbach, lav innun chashivin kelum, vela mafsikin benach leven kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, vechol bene alma deate, umalachin, dehachi yeul legabbach beinnun challonin, deayynin, veudenin, venukeve chotama, ufuma. kemalka deyeul beitkasyay lechadre chadarim, lemallela im bereh. uvegin da, metzalin yisrael beh bitzlota dilhon, (Mishlei 20:27) atta chofes kol chadre beten roe kelayot valev veen kol davar nelam mimmeka.

Vehayeynu deamar shelomo, (Shir HaShirim 2:9) mashgiach min hachallonot vegomer. veillen innun challonot, deayynin veudenin venukeve chotama ufuma beillen shiva nukevin, nishmeta selikat, beshiva mine busemin, vehachi tzelota selikat beillen 7 busemin, deinnun (Shir HaShirim 4:14) nard vecharkom kane vekinnamon im kol atze levona mor vaahalot im kol rashe besamim. behahu zimna ditzlota hachi selikat, mekutteret mor vechulei. hakadosh baruch hu shail alah, (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mi zot ola min hammidbar mekutteret mor ulevona vegomer. mi zot vadday, missitra demi ihu vadday bina, kelila mishshiva mini busemin.

Veda keriat shema, kelila mechamshin tarin, deinnun 25 25. kelila mishshiva birkan, bashshachar shetayim lefaneha, veachat leachareha, uveerev shetayim lefaneha, ushetayim leachareha. veinnun, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) haggedola vehaggevura vehattiferet vehannetzach vehahod, ad lecha Adonai hammamlacha, deihi malchut. deihi kelila mittelat busemin. mekutteret mor, da keter. ulevona, da chachma. mikkol avkat rochel, da bina. kum ashlim pikkudin demarach.

(Shemot 23:2) lo tihye achare rabbim leraot vegomer, achare rabbim lehattot. achare rabbim lehattot, let rabbim pachut mig vei let bet din beg, let lehattot batar dineh. bet din: shechinta. beg: telat chivan demerkavta dilah, veihi din tora, din emet, ammuda deemtzaita. vechol dayyayn dela dan din emet laamitto, da ihu keillu ashlit samael bealma. (Daniel 8:12) vetashlech emet artza, veappil shechinta immeh, veyakim gehinnam, bat zugeh desamael, im samael. baatar dedin emet, yokim sefat shaker. din emet, ammuda deemtzaita. sefat shaker gehinnam vesamael.

Uvegin da, kad dayyayn dan din, gehinnam petucha lefanav mishshomolo, bat zugeh desamael. vecherev al tzavvaro, malach hammavet. samael meachoroy meal tzavvareh. vegan eden patuach limineh, veetz hachayyim patuach lekammeh, al resheh.

I dan dina deshikra, shalit aleh malach hammavet, veshachit leh, ulevatar okid leh baggihinnam. vei dan din emet, kudesha berich hu yeul leh legan eden, veatim leh meilana dechayye, dichtiv aleh, (Bereshit 3:22) velakach gam meetz hachayyim veachal vachay leolam. deitbere beorayyta, deittemar bah, etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah. etz chayyim, tiferet. (Vayikra 58 amud alef, Tikkunim 66 amud bet) chayyim dileh chachma uvina. chayye hammelech vadday.

Uleolam, dina demalchuta, dina. vedina ballev, veittemar beh, hallev roe. uvegin da, en lo laddayyayn ella ma sheenav root. vehacha let dayyayn, ella kudesha berich hu. ma sheenav root, (divrei hayamim 2 16:9) ki Adonai enav meshottot. (Iyov la) enav al darche ish.

Uvehon, (Shir HaShirim 2:9) mashgiach min hachallonot. bez nukevin devar nash, bitren ayynin, uteren udenin, uteren nukevin dechotama, ufuma. ha 7 deima illaa. vehachi beovadoy istakkal besheva, missitra dishchinta tattaa, bev yedin vetzavvar telat, veguf uverit teren, ha chamesh. teren raglin, ha sheva. yah, yod hei, besheva atvavn dileh, istakkal besheva nukevin deresha,
732: Nekavim: al shem nekeva, dinkaveha petuchot lekabbel. 11, vav hei, besheva atvavn dileh, istakkal beshiva evarin diltatta, deinnun tikkuna degufa, dibbehon asiyyayt hammitzvot.

Ishto kegufo damya. veal shem pikkudin, itkeriu evarim. al shem shechinta, gufa. demistera achara levusha, deinnun or uvasar. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 10:11) or uvasar talbisheni uvaatzamot vegidim tesochcheni, baatar delet shechinta, hahu gufa la itkere, ella levusha deadam. deihu tora, (Bamidbar 19:14) zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel. (yeshaya ma) ketiferet adam lashevet bayit. uvaatar detamman mitzva, itkere gufa deadam, kegon gufi halachot, ufiske dinin.

Kudesha berich hu shofet, ammuda deemtzaita. missitra devina, deihu Adonai. (118 amud alef) dayyayn, missitra demalchut. shoter, hu shallit, (missitra deyosef hatztzaddik mittamman 1) veyosef hu hashshallit. vechol sefirayn, innun shoftim, missitra deima illaa, detiferet shofet. veinnun shotrim, missitra demalchut. detzaddik mittamman shoter umoshel. (ufikkuda batar da maynavey Shoftim vechulei timtzaennu beresh parashat Shoftim daf 274 amud bet)

(Shemot 23:7) middevar sheker tirchak venaki vetzadik al taharog vegomer. pikkuda lehashevot habbaale dinin, ulehitrachek middevar sheker, dela yemrun masso panim (yesh baddavar). dekudesha berich hu ittemar beh, (Devarim 10:17) asher lo yissa panim. velo yikkach sochad, besofe tevot echad. hay dayyayn, tzarich lemehve kegavvna deechad, deihu Adonai echad, dela yikkach sochad, dihe ihu bediyyukeneh.
Uvedina lehashevot tarvavyyhu keechad, vela yatte dina leda yattir min da, ella betikla chad, ad dikabbelon dina. ulevatar, kol chad ittedan, kefum ovadoy.

Veukemuha mare matnitin, tzaddik yetzer hattov shofto. rasha, yetzer hara shofto. benoni, ze veze shofto. man deihu meilana dechayye, let leh dina kelal, let leh yetzer hara, veda tzaddik gamur, veda tzaddik vetov lo. velet tov, ella tora. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:2) ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu. vetzadik vera lo, missitra deetz haddaat tov vara. vaamay itkere tzaddik batar dera lo, deihu yetzer hara. ella, begin detov shallit aleh, itkere tzaddik vera lo. dehahu ra ihu techot reshuteh. (sefer acher keavda techot rabbeh)

Rasha vetov lo, amay itkere rasha. begin deihu istallak lemehve resha yetzer hara dileh, vetov ihu techot reshuteh, keavda techot rabbeh. veaf al gav derasha ihu machtir et hatztzaddik, veyachil tzaddik gamur leanasha leh, (Mishlei 17:26) gam anosh latztzadik lo tov, begin hahu tov deihu techot ragloy derasha, let leanasha leh, deulay yachazor bitshuva veyitgabber al yitzreh, vihe afar techot ragloy.

Demistera derasha vetov lo, (nusach acher shechinta) shechivat, (Rut 3:7) vattegal margelotav vattishkav. hay ihu (Mishlei 30:23) veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah. (davar achar umissitra detzaddik gamur) shifcha, yetzer hara nukeba. yetzer hara, dechar. begineh ittemar, (Yeshayahu 42:8) uchevodi leacher lo etten. (Bamidbar 1:nusach acher) vehazzar hakkarev yumat.

Umissitra detzaddik vera lo, shechinta ihi attara al resha devar nash, veshifcha yetzer hara, itkafyay techot gevirtah. umissitra detzaddik gamur, let zar, velet yetzer hara. umissitra derasha gamur, let leh chulaka bishchinta, delet chulaka lebar nash bishchinta, ella missitra detov.

Velet kol shechinta shekilin, deha shechinta deilana detov vara, ihu kurseyay, aval shechinta deilana dechayye, alah ittemar, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra. aval (davar acher ella) begin deittemar bah, (Tehillim 103:19) umalchuto bakkol mashala, man defagim atar dilah, itchashiv keillu avid bematronita kelana. dekalana dematronita ihu, man dimzalzel beatraha. ukelana dematronita, demalka ihu.

Kol shekken man deabar lah meatraha, veshavve shifcha beatraha. divchol atar deihu pagim, matronita la sharya tamman, ella shifcha, deihi pegima, sharya baatar pagim. ufegimu devar nash dechovoy, pagim bechol evarin dileh, ad dela ashkachat matronita atar lesharya tamman. velet leh tikkuna
733: Ad deyachazir lah al kol evarin dileh.

Amar butzina kaddisha, raya mehemana, begin da, ant metakken, bechibbura da, dermch pikkudin. leamlecha lekudesha berich hu al kol evarim dishchinta, bechol pikkuda ufikkuda, velet ant chayish likarach. zakkaa chulakach, dichgavvna deant mamlich lekudesha berich hu bechol evarim dishchinta, deinnun baale middot, dechol yisrael. mare middot innun evarim dishchinta, hachi avid kudesha berich hu lesharya shemeh alach, veyamlechinach, al kol mashreyayn illain vetattain (Shoftim 275 amud alef lo yakum ad echad).

Kum raya mehemana, lesaddera dinin behilchot nezikin, besiddura dishma da, havaya. deihu, (Tehillim 68:18) rechev elohim ribbotayim alfe shinan, deinnun, shor nesher arye adam, deha missitra dimina, detamman Adonai, 4 chivavn, hachi ihu siddura dilhon, adam arye nesher shor. uchefum shinnuyin dehavayayn, hachi ihu tenua vesiddura dechevan. vechevan desitra achara, deinnun nezikin dismala, hachi siddurayyhu, shinan. uvegin da, hatechala dilhon, hashshor. kashur bed avot nezikin, hashshor vehabbor vehammave vehahever vesiyyuma dilhon adam, muad.

Kum atar bedinin. patach raya mehemana veamar, (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach ufi yaggid tehillatecha. adonay, behippuch atvavn dina. uvegin da, amru mare matnitin, dina demalchuta dina. kol dinin behay shema itdanu. (sefer acher baAdonai 6 vechulei) bed, beg. bed: shechinta (sefer acher bet din 5 bet din shechinta 5) lokovel telat avahan. ammuda deemtzaita, dayyayn emet, vehu dayyayn, ladun missitra daadonay, detamman ihu dayyayn emet. umissitra deshem elohim, shofet. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 75:8) ki elohim shofet.

Uma dinin innun. chad, ladun benizke shor. tinyayna, ladun benizke bor. telitaa, ladun benizke esh. reviaa, ladun benizke adam. vaavatrayyhu, ladun bedine arba shomrim. shomer chinnam. veshomer sachar. vehashshoel. venose sachar. (sefer acher vehassocher) lokovlayyhu, dinin arbea. din chalukat hashshuttafim. din chalukat karkaot. dine avadim ushefachot. dine tovea venitba, bechamma mine teviot dechiyyuv mamon, vegezel, vaaveda, o shemmazzik lachavero, vehorgo beechad mearba mitot bet din.

Adon ihu kudesha berich hu, baadonay. ladun bechol mini dinin, leshifcha bisha, ki tirash gevirtah. deminnah kol nezikin ishtechachu, deinnun (kol) malache chabbala, deminnayyhu nishmathon shel reshaim, kema deukemuha mare matnitin, (Bereshit 29 amud alef) nishmot harshaim hen hen hammazzikim baolam. el acher, mazzik, gazlan rasha. uvat zugeh, sam hammavet.

Nezek shevet uvoshet verippuyy, lishchinta uvenaha. shevet, devitula deorayyta, devatilat livnaha. verippuyy, degarmat lon demitrappin middivre tora. nezek, bechamma nezikin demalache chabbala, mare mashchit af vechema. uvoshet, dahavo mevazzin lishchinta bekochavim umazzalot, shikra dilhon, vahavu amrin ayye elohecha. vechamma gezelot min shifcha bisha, deittemar bah (Yeshayahu 3:14) gezelat heani bevattechem.

Kamma birkan, gazlat lishchinta, shifcha bisha. bechoved hammas, uvechoved kamma dinin meshunim al benaha, vechamma karbenin deve makdesha, divtilat lematronita. uvoshet dematronita, deishtearat aruma, med bigde zahav denaharin, med ture aven, 14 avanin margelan. meil bechamma zagin verimmonim. vearba bigde lavan, dibbehon havat matronita, mitkashsheta kodam malka. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam. vegazlat lah liggevirtah, kamma maachalin dekarbenin.

Shor muad balah, al leve malka (191 amud alef) ribboneh, bearba avot nezikin dileh, (deinnun, 1 ufene shor mehassemol learbatam) avon umashchit af vechema, dechullehu muadin lekalkel. begufa dileh, hirbitz al hakkelim, mizbach menora shulchan ushear manin, ravatz alayyhu veshibberatan. uveshen dileh, achil kol karbenin dimmaachalim defatora, veshaara beragloy rafsa. (umiddeka kolla usheara deinnun amevahen vapedareyn shiyyeyre menachot beragloy rapesaa) uvekeren dileh, katal kahane velevae. haras kolla, (Eicha 2:2) chillel
734: Habbor, nukeba bisha, lilit, bevayit dilah, deihi bet hassohar, tefisat lematronita uvenaha, shifcha bisha, begaluta dilah, veshavvyayn lon, bechamma shalshelain vaasurin livnaha, yedayyhu mehaddekan laachora. (Eicha 1:3) hi yashva baggoyim lo matza manoach. velo od ella (Eicha 1:8) kol mechabbedeha hizziluha ki rau ervatah gam hi neencha vattashav achor.

Velo od, ella zona deihi hever, dehayynu esh, (Eicha 4:11) vayyatztzet esh betziyyon. levatar kam adam beliyyaal rasha, revii laavot nezikin, deittemar beh adam muad leolam, ben er ben yashen, veshillach et beiro, veachil veshetze vegada keramim ufardesim diyrushala 40, veshetze kolla.

Ribbon alma, ant keshot, veorayytach keshot, yahavat lan mitzvat tefilin, (43 amud alef) latzaddikim gemurim ihu agra kefum ovadayyhu, peer al reshayyhu. umeshammeshin laavuhon veimmehon, kegavvna degufa, dechol evarim dileh meshammeshin leresha. hachi itteta, meshammesha levalah.

Veit malachin deinnun meshammeshin legufa, umalachin dimshammeshin lenishmeta. uchegavvna deit afrashuta ben gufa lenishmeta, hachi it afrashuta ben malachin degufa, lemalachin denishmeta. veit nishmeta lenishmeta. umalachin lemalachin, (Kohelet Adonai:7) ki gavoah meal gavoah shomer ugevohim alehem. veillen deinnun nishmeta lenishmeta, kullehu chad. veaf al gav deorach mitla, innun kegufa etzel nishmeta illen leillen, begin dimkabbelin illen meillen. hachi shechinta, (nishmeta) af al gav deihi lokovel shear nehorin divria, kenishmeta etzel gufa, lokovel kudesha berich hu chashiva kegufa. aval kolla chad. hacha gufa venishmeta kolla chad. ma delav hachi bevar nash, degufeh venishmateh befiruda. da chomer, veda sechel. da chayye, veda mota. aval kudesha berich hu chayyim, ushechinteh chayyim, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah.

Vechol innun dirshimin besimanin dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, innun reshimin beyomin dechol, beot ditfilin, uveot demila. ureshimin bezachor veshamor beshabbat. reshimin battora shebbichtav, deityehivat mimina. uvattora shebbeal pe, deityehivat missemala. vekudesha berich hu, zachor mimina, veshamor missemala. ushechinta, zechira mimina, ushemira missemala. innun tefillin deresha debar nash, utefillin deyad. vehachi shechinta, (tehillim 19) torat Adonai temima, umitzva dileh. vehay missitra deammuda deemtzaita, deihu kalil dina verachame. zachor veshamor. itkeriat ihi zechira shemira. uvechol pikkudin ihi shakila legabbeh bemadrega.

Aval missitra dechesed, kudesha berich hu zachor, ushechinta shamor. kema deukemuha mare matnitin, zachor lezachar, veshamor lechalla. begin devimina uvismala anpin mitpardin, kegavvna dechanfe rea, deinnun perudot millemala. lokovlayyhu chevan, (Yechezkel 1:11) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot millemala. velokovel petuchot desefer tora. letatta tarvavyyhu beyichuda chada, kegon setumot desefer tora, delet tamman piruda. uvegin da, baatar deyichuda, deihu gufa, dome lashshidra delulav, im nifretzu, o nifredu alav pasul.

Bechamma reshimin rashim kudesha berich hu leyisrael, leishtemoda legabbe malachin. illen dimina, detalyayn mekudesha berich hu. o illen dismala, detalyayn mishchinta. o illen detalyayn mekudesha berich hu. ushechinteh beyichuda chada. vadday illen deit behon tora, reshimin bechesed. veillen deit behon mitzva, reshimin bigvura. veillen mare ditfilin, veot shabbat, veot berit, reshimin betzaddik.

Uveiran, amme haaretz, innun reshimin beabaru dearla uferia. ofin, bezefek uvekurkevan niklaf, beabaru dezefek, ukelifa dekurkevan innun reshimin ofin lemechal, uveiran, bitre simanin, maalat gera, umafreset parsa. kullehu reshimin bitre simanin, kegavvna dearla uferia, demitabberan miamma kaddisha.
Aval talmide chachamim, kullehon reshimin minnehon, bechurseyay. uminnehon, bemalache, bearba chevan dechurseyay. minnehon bechochavayya
735: Uvemazzale. uminnehon reshimin, bemidot dekudesha berich hu ishtemodin. veinnun demitassekin beorayyta uvemitzvot, lishma dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, shello al menat lekabbel peras, ella kivra deihu mechuyayv bikara daavohi veimmeh, da itkashshar vadday veitreshim, beammuda deemtzaita ushechinteh, keillu beh havo chad. uman deit beh tora belo mitzva, o mitzva belo tora, kivyachol keillu havo beh befiruda. aval beda veda, keilana, deanpoy mitpardin limina velismala, veilana yichuda detarvavyyhu, beemtzaita.

Rashiayya, innun reshimin bela simanin detohora, innun delet lehon tefillin al resha, uderoa. veinnun dela reshimin battora uvammitzvot. veillen dela natrin zachor veshamor. vela reshimin bitchelet velavan detzitzit. veillen dela reshimin beillen simanin, sheketz hem lachem, lav innun yisrael ella amme haaretz. ma illen sheketz vesheretz, uf innun (nusach acher 70) sheketz vesheretz. kema deukemuha mare matnitin, amme haaretz hem sheretz, uneshotehem sheketz. veal benotehem ittemar, (Devarim 27:21) arur shochev im kol behema.

Umitathon mita beitgalya, velet mita ella aniyyuta, umita daaniyyuta dilhon, la yehe beitkasya, keofin dedamyayn lemare pikkudin, ella beitgalleyay, leeni amma, deani chashuv kammet. veit aniyyuta beitkasya, meeni bene nasha. veit aniyyuta, leeni kolla. kizriku dedam divhema, uzerikatah leene kolla, deshafchin dama kame kolla. hachi aniyyin shafchin damoy beanpayyhu, leene beni nasha, veithadderin yerokin kammetin.

Vei haderin betiuveta, vela patchin pumehon lehattiach devarim kelappe mala umita dilhon bistimu defuma, kivira deihi meta, velet lah kol vedibbur. uveviduy hachi yiyima ihu, en li pe lehashiv, velo metzach leharim rosh, veyitvadde umeyayched lekudesha berich hu bechol yoma, lemeheve mitateh beechad. kegavvna dishchitat behema, bitresar bedikot desakkin, uvesakkin deinnun echad.

Umevarecha umekaddesh lekudesha berich hu bechol yoma, bevarchu uvikdushsha, uvechol achila ushetiyya dileh. kegavvna dimvarech kahana, baruch atta, ha beracha. asher kiddeshanu, ha kedusha. kad rucha mevarach lekudesha berich hu, bechol yoma bevaruch, umekaddesh leh bikdusha dileh, umeyached leh beyichuda deihu shechinteh. kudesha berich hu nachit al hahu rucha bechamma mashreyayn.

Eliyyahu, vadday bar nash dimvarech umekaddesh, umeyached lematronita, kamma mashreyayn dematronita sallekin immeh, umashshiryayn demalka, nachtin legabbeh. vechullehu lenatra leh, uleodaa leh lehahu rucha, kamma chidushin vaatidot, bechelmin dinvua, vechamma setarim. kegavvna deyaakov, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 28:12) vehinni malache elohim olim veyordim bo. veal mashreyayn demalka umatronita ittemar, (Bereshit 32:3) vayyikra shem hammakom hahu machanayim. aval malka umatronita la nachtin tamman.

Amar eliyyahu, raya mehemana, hachi hu vadday. aval begin divchol pikkuda ufikkuda, hava ishtaddeluta dilach, leyachada kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, bechol mashreyayn deella vetatta, hachi kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, vechol mashshiryayteh ella vetatta, mityachadin berucha dilach, bechol pikkuda ufikkuda, kivra demalka, deabba veima rachamin leh, venashkin leh, uvachavivu dileh, la hemnin leh bemashshiryayn dilhon, ella innun gufayyhu, natrin leh.

Begin dehahu rucha dilach, missitra deammuda deemtzaita ihu, deihu 6 kalil abba veimma, deinnun yah. nefesh dilach. bat yechida, missitra deat Adonai, shechinta tattaa, la zazat minach. uchegavvna deabba veimma natrin bera, hachi natrin berata. bemashshiryayn illain, deinnun machanayim. uvemachashava illaa, sallekin lerucha dilach, kema deukemuha, yisrael ala bemachashava, yod hei vav hei. veematay rucha dilach selikat bemachashava. kad ihi shelema, veittemar bah, (Tehillim 150:6) kol hanneshama tehallel yah.
736: Ruach Adonai ittemar beh, (Yechezkel 37:9) ko amar Adonai mearba ruchot boi haruach. veinnun, (Yeshayahu 11:2) ruach Adonai, ruach chachma uvina, ruach etza ugevura vegomer, (shelim) shalom bearba atvavn, salik bemachashava, veillat haillot meatter leh becheter. bechol hay yekar, rucha dilach, salik venachit bechol lelya. vechol millin deitgalleyayn (nusach acher lecha bechesed vealayyhu ittemar veattem vechulei) al keter (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai, attem, vela umin ovde kochavim umazzalot. uvegin da, (Shemot 22:19) zoveach leelohim yochoram, elohim acherim. bilti laAdonai levaddo.

Zakkaa amma kaddisha, deitkeriu ana dekudesha berich hu, lemikrav garmayyhu karbenin kameh. kema deittemar, (Tehillim 44:23) ki alecha horagnu kol hayyom nechshavnu ketzon tivcha. ukarvin garmayyhu keanin, betaanita. demiut chelba vedama, detaanita, ihu chashiv yattir mikkarbena diviran, dehava mitmaet dama vechelba vechol innun emurin ufedarin, demitakkelin kol lelya.

Zakkain innun, (sefer acher yisrael) dimkarvin ruchin dilhon, karbenin kodam Adonai. uvechol lelya velelya, derucha dilhon hi haola legabbeh, i salik lah, battora umitzva, battora, deihi eser amiran, deityeyhivu meat 10 divasar dibberan, meatvavn 10. (sefer acher 8, beshit) beshit chumeshe tora besefer bereshit. chamisha innun deitkeriu chamisha chumeshe tora. shetitaa sefer bereshit ikre. uvemachashava deihu yod hei vav hei, deittemar beh, yisrael ala bemachashava. ulean atar salik. legabbe keter detamman illat haillot, mufele umechusa.

Zakkaa man desalik leh bammitzva, deihi mitzvat tefilin, dibbehon arba parshiyyot, dibbehon shem Adonai. 10: kaddesh li. Adonai: vehaya ki yeviacha. 6: shema yisrael. Adonai: vehaya im shamoa. bemachashava. lekashshera lah beyad, dishchinta ihu 15 kelila mimmaase deihi Adonai. vedibbur deihi bina, kelila 6 sefiran. uvemachashava deihu yod hei vav hei, Adonai. 14 atvavn, kechushevan yad. veitremizu bearba parshiyayn, uveta ditfilin 1, uteren retzue deresha, (nusach acher vedidah) sheva. ditren shinin tesha. vekesher dirtzua eser. ved parshiyayn deyad, (sefer acher hare 14.) yad dishchinta, yad Adonai.

Beginah ittemar, (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi vegomer. ruach itpekad laydod. vekudesha berich hu nachit legabbeh, lekabbela leh legabbe shechinta. venatre leh kudesha berich hu ushechinteh. uman garim da. man divchol mitzva umitzva, salik shechinta legabbe kudesha berich hu.

Ve (Vayikra 249 amud bet) tevin deyaancha Adonai beyom tzara. uvemay tzevavchat. ella vadday yisrael it behon mare tora, malachim, missitra deayyelet hashshachar, deihi shechinta. uteren dargin innun, boker veshachar, vealayyhu ittemar, (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha netzach. (110 amud alef) boker deavraham, deihu chesed, da salik yattir beyoma defurekana, aval shachar akdim leyoma defurekana. umay ihu. netzach, dishchinta missitreh itkeriat ayyelet hashshachar.

Uvegin da, 70 netzach, tamman netzach, tamman 70. deinnun 70 kalin detzavavchat ayyelet hashshachar al benaha, deittakkaf alayyhu kadruta begaluta, shacharut hashshachar be shenin batrain, (beshivim) behahu zimna yitkayyem beyisrael, (Yeshayahu 26:17) kemo hara takriv laledet tachil tizak bachavaleha ken hayinu mippanecha Adonai. veal ken nekavve lach Adonai elohenu.

Uvehon ayyelet ailat reshaha ben birkaha. resha, ihu tzaddik yesod olam. ben birkaha deinnun netzach vehod. veume lah beh, lemifrak livnaha babboker, deihu arye boker yemina deavraham, mashiach ben david denafik mihuda, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 49:9) gur arye yehuda. uvegin da, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker.

Uvah (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto bokea mayim vegomer, begin detiferet darga demoshe gufa, vechesed deroa dileh, umoshe itkashshar bev deihu chesed, darga deavraham. dehachi salik bechushevan 18. 18 min vayyissa vayyavo vayyet, telat anfe avahan, 300. deitkashshar besh shel moshe. deittemar behon (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene arye el hayyamin learbatan ufeni shor mehassemol vegomer, ufene nesher learbatan. 45 min moshe, udemut penehem pene adam.
(Sefer acher deihu) deroa semala, ittemar beh, semol docha, vimin mekarevet. deaf al gav
737: Deakdim betishre, deukemuha beh mare matnitin, betishre atidin lehiggael. tehe docha, begin dela yamut mashiach ben efrayim, docha metishre deihi semol. ad deyikrav yamin, pesach deroa yemina. lekayyem bah, (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot vehay ihu benisan nigalu uvenisan atidin lehiggael. lekayyem behon (Yeshayahu 54:8) uvechesed olam richamtich amar goalech Adonai.

Ulevatar natle kullehu miggevura, deminneh mashiach ben efrayim, lenatla nukema missanoy. dehachi bae lenakkaa ibbura, deinnun yisrael, bimina. ulevatar leokda kash, bismala. hada hu dichtiv, (Ovadya 1:18) vehaya vet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash vedalku bahem vaachalum. uchenishu deibbura, da ammuda deemtzaita. beh (Bereshit 25) vayyeasef (el ammav). lean atar. leveta, da shechinta.

Aval bedarga demashiach ben yosef, ihu deka ramiz, (Bamidbar 22:4) atta yelachachu hakkahal et kol sevivotenu kilchoch hashshor et yerek hassade. dealayyhu ittemar, (Tehillim 92:8) bifroach reshaim kemo esev vegomer. mippesach vead tishre, yehe purekana deihu ad. umittamman veelach yehe hashemada dilhon, (Tehillim 92:8) lehishshamdam (purekana) ade ad. (nusach acher velo ad bichlal, ella ad demate laad, mittamman vaelach lehishshamdam ede ad) kad matu letishre deihu shor, beh kilchoch hashshor.

Usemicha (sefer acher deyisrael umatu dilhon bimina vechulei) dilhon deyisrael, bimina deihu arye. aval kima dilhon begufa deilana. vehay ihu kol hakkorea korea bevaruch, tzaddik. deittemar beh beyosef hatztzaddik, (Bereshit 37:7) vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavena laalummati. vehay ihu, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker. vechol hazzokef zokef beshem, darga demoshe rabbenu leella. (sefer acher uvemoshe) umoshe letatta, beh yekumun kol yisrael, keevarin degufa, deveh kullehu zekifin baamida. uvehay ihu kol hazzokef, zokef beshem, begin dealeh ittemar, (Shemot 33) vaedaacha beshem,

Yehon mashiach ben david, deihu arye, mimineh. umashiach ben yosef, deihu shor, missemaleh. mimina avraham, missemala yitzchak, veihu nesher beemtzaita. shalshelet dilhon, missitra deyaakov. 300 demoshe, kedusha lecha yeshalleshu. missitra dearye, 3 anpin daavahan, itkeriu arayot. boker. missitra dismala itkeriu parim menaggechim. umissitra (80 amud bet) deemtzaita, itkeriu nesharim. vealayyhu ittemar (Shemot 19:4) veeshsha etchem al kanfe nesharim vaavi etchem elay. ha innun 9. ashiraa, ureviaa, adam (45 346) demoshe derachiv al telat chevavn.

Veittemar beyisrael, (Bereshit 1:26) veyirdu vidgat hayyam, memanan deyamma, besitra denachash, dehava sara demitzrayim, deitpashshat begaluta batraa, miyyam ad yam. uveof hashshamayim, irbuveya bisha. amalekim, (Bereshit 205 amud alef) nefilim, taarovet dechol umin, bechol sitra, begaluta batraa, ben beyisrael, ben beyishmael, ben beesav. (baummot haolam) uvabbehema, illen bene esav. deshuletantehon bechol haaretz.

Veyitkayyem bemashiach, (Tehillim 72:8) veyyerd miyyam ad yam uminnahar ad afse aretz. vehachi bev meshichin, vehachi beyisrael, vecholla bizchut 45 (346) demoshe. veyetun, nes demashiach ben david, mihuda, arye rashim aleh, venis demashiach ben yosef, shor rashim aleh. venes deshilo, arye limina, shor lismala, nesher beemtzaita, veadam al kullehu. ved anpin lechol chad. 4 shevatin deg chevan, 12. ulegabbe adam, deihu ma shemo, bene moshe, divhahu zimna yitkeyaym bemoshe (Bamidbar 14:12) veeese otcha legoy gadol veatzum mimmennu. behahu zimna, (Kohelet 3) ma shehaya hu sheyyihye. (Kohelet 3:15) vaasher lihyot kevar haya.

Vehaelohim yevakkesh et nirdaf, yisrael deittemar behon, (Yechezkel la) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem, havo nirdafim kodam erev rav, zeevim bishin, ha (Bereshit 49:27) binyamin zeev yitraf legabbayyhu, detarif lon, veyitkayyem behahu zimna, babboker yochal ad. dehayynu ad ki yavo shilo, veda boker deavraham. ulaerev yechallek shalal da erev deyitzchak, detamman teren meshichin. bechad yechul (sefer acher mamona) memana deumin dealma. uvechad yechallek lon leyisrael.
Yisrael deinnun ayyelet, nirdafin kodam rashshiayya arayot. veyittear naftali, deihu ayyala shelucha hannoten imre shafer. yittear bimina
738: Deihu arye mashiach ben david, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 49:9) gur arye yehuda mitteref beni alita. veychozkun (davar acher veyachzor) al umin dealma, kara shachav alayyhu, lemitraf lon mi yekimennu, behahu zimna nechoze man hu eloah achara, deyakim leh millitrof alayyhu, o uma velishan.

Veyisrael dahavo kayyona, nirdafin kadam nesher, missitra deofin deumin dealma. behahu zimna, yittear nesher, veyitperash gadfaha, al irbuve deumin, veesav veyishmael, deinnun amalekim, veirbuveya bisha deyisrael, vetarif lon, dela yishtear chad minnayyhu, lekayyem ma shenneemar beyisrael, (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar.

Mittamman veelach, en mekabbelim gerim, kema deukemuha mare matnitin en mekabbelim gerim limot hammashiach. veumin ovde kochavim umazzalot dealma deyishtaarun, yittear kudesha berich hu chayya deadam, leshalletaa alayyhu. lekayyeyma behon, (Yeshayahu 60:12) ki haggoy vehammamlacha asher lo yaavduch yovedu. lekayyem beyisrael, (Bereshit 1:26) veyyirdu vidgat hayyam vegomer. (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem vegomer.

Umissitra ditvuot, Adonai mine nahama, tevirin mikkullehu. veinnun, chitta, useora, uchussemet, veshibbolet shual, veshifon. imtil lon leyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, baAdonai. kad yifkun miggaluta, hachi yehon tevirin, ad deyitberir ochel mittoch pesolet, dehayynu kash, erev rav, ad deyitbarru veyishtemodu yisrael benayyhu, kevar, deitberir miggo motz vateven.

Vead deyitberiru minnayyhu, 10 deihu maaser, la sharya al Adonai, deihu nahama, de minin, lekayyeyma umaa, (Shemot 17:16) ki yad al kes yah. uvegin da, motz vateven, eno mechuyayv bemaaser, ad deyitberir. levatar deyitberir, mitkanneshin lehahu atar deikre yerushala 40. kema dechitta, devatar deitberir kash vateven, machnisin lah laotzar. hachi yitkanneshun yisrael, deinnun bar, liyrushala 40, deihi benuya al har Adonai, deittemar bah, (Tehillim 24:3-4) mi yaale vehar Adonai umi yakum bimkom kadsho neki chappayim uvar levav. naki kabbar, deihi ibbura kad barir miggo pesolet. behahu zimna, nashsheku bar kedivkadmeta, deittemar beh, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu. bar targum ben, behahu zimna dihon nekiyyim kabbar, miggo kash veteven. sharya shemeh alayyhu, vekara lon, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael.

Vehachi mikkol ilanin, let tevir kaggefen. bintiu dileh tevir, baanavim dileh tevir, deinnun ketishin ben raglin. vehachi zayit zetim dilah ketishin. begaluta amtilu yisrael behon, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 80:9) gefen mimmitzrayim tassia. vechen begalut reviaa, (Yeshayahu Adonai:7) ki cherem Adonai tzevaot bet yisrael. uchegavvna da lazzayit meshulim yisrael, (Yirmeyahu 11:16) zayit raanan yefe feri toar. uvegin da, (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha banecha kishtile zetim. samich da leda, begin deinnun tevirin begaluta.

Ulevatar dihon nekiyyim miggo pesolet, yitkaddeshun leve makdesha, beyayin lenassecha al gabbe madbecha, vezetim leadleka botzina sheraggin limnarta. uman zacha lehay. yayin dela yitnesach lekochavim umazzalot. deerev rav innun yayin denitnesach lekochavim umazzalot, uminnehon meshumadim, minim, eppikorsim meshumadim laaverot shebbechol hattora kulah.

Veyisrael deittemar behon (tehillim 126) vayyitarvu vaggoyim vayyilmedu maasehem. ad dihon deruchin ben raglayyhu, begaluta la itberiru minnayyhu. uveginayyhu amar david alav hashalom, (Tehillim 49:6-7) lamma ira bime ra avon akevay yesubbeni. vealayyhu amar shelomo, (Shir HaShirim 1:8) tzei lach beikve hatztzon. beyaakov. dealeh ittemar, legabbe nachash hakkadmoni defatte lechavva, (Bereshit 3:15) hu yeshufecha rosh veatta teshufennu akev. batar deyifkun min galuta, nimshalim letappuchim, ulechol rechin tavin. kegavvna demafkanu demitzrayim, dichtiv beh (Shir HaShirim 8:Adonai) tachat hattappuach orarticha.

Pikkuda batar da, lehavi bikkurim, vaavatreh lehitvaddot al habbikkurim, vaavatreh lehitvaddot al hammaaser. umare matnitin, makshim al hammaaser, dei yehe kodem lekitato, o achar lekitato issuro. kegon etrog, deittemar beh beilan, halach achar chanata. it man deamar, achar bishshul happerot. veetrog miktzato dome leilan, umiktzato lattevua, deinnun zeraim, deittemar behon, dilachar lekitato issuro. deilan lav ihu, ella ad achar gemar bishshulo.
739: Meatar devishulo yafe. leappaka pat saruf, ella mimmakom shehu muteam. vehachi tevua, batar lekitato, ihu kevishul perot.

Veyisrael, innun meshulim lailan velattevua, deittemar behon (Shemot 23:19) reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha. vehachi (Devarim 18:4) reshit gez tzoncha titten lo. deinnun yisrael. deittemar behon, (Yechezkel la) veatten tzoni. vehachi yisrael, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh (nusach acher kodesh yisrael) laAdonai reshit tevuato, leachar lekitato min galuta, isuro. veitkeriu kodesh laAdonai.

Veyisrael itkeriu ilana rabba vetakkif, umazon lecholla beh. beh orayyta, deihi mezona leella. beh tzelota, deihi mezona letatta. (nusach acher leella) vaafillu malachin let lon mezona, ella beyisrael. dei lav deyisrael yitassekun beorayyta, la hava nachit lon mezona, mistar deorayyta, deamtila laetz, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah. uleiva, deihi mitzva.

Vehachi orayyta amtila lemayya. vehane leeshsha. vela hava nachit mayya milleella, vechama deihi eshsha, la hava nachit (sefer acher milleella) levashshela perot hailan. ella, begin yisrael. uvegin da ittemar beyisrael, (Shir HaShirim 2:13) hatteena chanta faggeha, illen mare mitzvot. vehaggefanim semadar natnu reach, kad patchin betiuveta, umiyyad ittemar beyisrael, kumi lach rayati yafati ulechi lach, min galuta.

Uvegin da beilan, deihu etz hachayyim, beorayyta, beillen demishtaddelin bah, azlin batar chanata, umeasserin leh, desharya yod alayyhu, deihi chachma, 1 mi uva mitkanneshin 10, deinnun perot hailan. uman ilan. 6. aval shear amma, achar lekitato min galuta, issuro. innun tzaddikim deittemar behon, (Vayikra 23:40) ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar. hadar beovadehon, daachidan bemare tora umitzvot, veachar chanata azlenan legabbayyhu (nusach acher ulegabbe zeraim ditvua veachar chanata azlinan legabbayyhu) keilan.

Uvegin da ukemuha bemassechet kiddushin, veka mashma lan deetrog keyarak, ma yarak darko ligadel al kol mayim, uvishat lekitato isuro. uf etrog name darko ligadel vechulei umissitra dechachma, en mayim ella tora. uvaatar achara leella, veha ditnan, etrog shav lailan bishlosha derachim, ha etrog, achid 2 sitrin, veetrog ihu diyyukena delibba, deachid leella veachid letatta. achid leella, hallev roe. achid letatta, bedaat. kema deukemuha, hallev yodea. daat ihi ilana, tora iva dileh. ayynin deinnun pikkudin, dibbehon hallev roe. (ad kan raya mehemana, shalach lecha daf 174 amud alef reshit arisotechem vechulei).

(Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach, (Iyov 28:12) vehachachma meayin timmatze veeze mekom bina. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu bae leyakkera lon, yatir (nusach acher bikara dilhon) al kol shear beni alma. bekadmita amar lon, (Shemot 19:6) veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim. la ade rechimuta sagia minnehon, ad dekara lon vegoy kadosh deihu yatir. la ade rechimuta minnehon, ad dekara lon (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta. la ade rechimuta minnehon, ad dekara lon (Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li deihu yatir mikkolla.

Ketiv vehachachma meayin timmatze. orayyta (Bereshit 47 amud bet) mechachma nafkat, meatar deikre (59) kodesh. vehachachma nafkat, meatar deikre kodesh hakkodashim. ribbi yitzchak amar, vechen yovla itkere kodesh. dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:12) yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem. veyisrael kelilan minnayyhu, hada hu dichtiv veanshe kodesh tihyun li.

Bekadmita kadosh, vehasheta kodesh. ma (Vayikra 299 amud alef) ben hay lehay. amar ribbi yosi, da leella leella, veda lav hachi. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushala 40 kadosh yeamer lo. behay atar ikre
740: Rabbi abba hava azil bearcha, vahavu azle immeh ribbi yosi veribbi chiyyay, amar ribbi chiyyay, (sefer acher detanenan) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, menalan. amar leh, ha ribbi yosi vechullehu chavrayyay shappir kamru, vehachi hu. menalan. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, reshit: vadday chachma ikre rishit, dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai.

Umishshum deyisrael ikrun kodesh (yisrael) bishlimu decholla, ketiv (Shemot 22:30) uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu. deha yisrael deinnun shelemin al kolla, la yankin missitra dedina kashya. lakkelev tashlichun oto. lakkelev vadday, dehu dina chatzifa takkifa al kolla. kevan dedina takkifa sharya aloy, veatil zuhama beh, asir lehu leinun deikrun kodesh. ella lakkelev tashlichun oto vadday, deihu dina chatzifa, dina takkifa yattir mikkolla, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:11) vehakkelavim azze nefesh.

Ta chaze, kad idkar nevela beorayyta, ketiv beyisrael kadosh, vela kodesh. hacha ketiv, veanshe kodesh tihyun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu. vehatam binnevela ketiv, (Devarim 14:21) lo tochlu chol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittennna vegomer, ki am kadosh atta. kadosh velo kodesh, deha nevela missitra deyisrael itavid, dela pasil hay ella yisrael. vesaggiin gavvnin, it bah binnevela. kema deokimna.

Amar rabbi shimon, ketiv hacha veanshe kodesh tihyun li, uchetiv hatam ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha. laAdonai elohecha, li mibbae leh. ella hatam (sefer acher ella hacha) leella leella. vehacha (sefer acher vehatam) shechinta. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushalam kadosh yeamer lo vela kodesh. bechan kadosh, uleella kodesh. ketiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, beHei kema deokimna. veal da veanshe kodesh tihyun li vadday.

Rabbi yitzchak hava yativ kameh derabbi shimon, amar leh ha ketiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai sofye dikra ketiv kol ochlav yeshamu, may ka mayyre. amar leh rabbi shimon, shappir ka amar, kol ochlav yeshamu, hayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:14) veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga vegomer. uchetiv, vechol zar lo yochal kodesh. umishshum deyisrael ikrun kodesh, ketiv kol ochlav yeshamu. ata ribbi yitzchak venashik yedoy, amar, i la attena hacha ella lemishma milla da sagge.

Amar leh rabbi, ha tanenan, dekodesh, yattir leella min kadosh. i hachi, ha ketiv (yeshaya 6) 100 100 100 Adonai tzevaot, veda shelimu decholla. amar leh ta chaze, kad mitchabberan kachada, kullehu itavidu chad beta, vehay (Vayikra 93) beta, ikre kodesh. kelala dechullehu kadosh uvegine kach kodesh, hu kelala, decholla itkelil beh. veyisrael kad itkelil behu mehemnuta shelemata kodesh ikrun, kelala decholla, dichtiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai. uvegine kach, veanshe kodesh tihyun li.

Ligyon chad shail lera abba, amar leh, la ketiv uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu, i hachi, may dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:5) teref natan lireav. teref natan lakkelavim mibbae leh, amay natan lireav. amar leh, reka, mi ketiv terefa natan lireav, teref ketiv. vei tema, teref kitrefa. natan lireav vadday demilla da, la yahaveh leizdahara beh, ella leinun dachale shemeh, vedachalin leh. begin kach hay milla la yahiv lechu, deha yada deattun la dachalin leh, vela natrin pikkudoy, uvegin dehay milla chumera deorayyta, uvae leizdahara bah, natan lireav, lireav vadday, vela leochore. vechol chomre deorayyta, la yahiv lon kudesha berich hu, ella leinun dachale chattaa, leinun dachale pikkudoy vela lechu.

Tane ribbi elazar, ketiv (sefer acher kodesh yisrael uchetiv veanshe vegomer) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, mahu veanshe. ulevatar kodesh, ella veanshe kodesh vadday. detanenan, la nafku yisrael lecheru, ella (Bereshit 31 amud bet) missitra deyovla. batar denafku lecheru, nakit lon hay yovla begadpoy, veikrun guverin dileh. benin dileh, uchetiv beh beyovla, (Vayikra 25:12) yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem, kodesh vadday, lachem vadday. uvegine kach, veanshe kodesh tihyun li, anshe kodesh vadday, guverin dileh mammash.
741: Veal da zachu yisrael leitkere achim lekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay vegomer. levatar ikrun kodesh mammash. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, kodesh vela anshe kodesh, begini kach kol ochlav yeshamu, uchetiv, (Vayikra 22:10) vechol zar lo ychal kodesh. (Vayikra 22:14) veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga.

Tana, yisrael ikrun kodesh, uvegin deinnun kodesh, asir leh leeynash, lemikre lechavreh bishma dignay, vela lechannaa shema lechavreh, veonsheh saggi. vechol shekken bemillin acharanin. tana, ketiv (tehillim la) netzor leshoncha mera vegomer. mahu mera. divgin lishana bisha, marin nachtin lealma.

Amar ribbi yosi kol man dekare lechavreh bishma delet beh, veganne leh, ittepas bema delet beh, deamar ribbi chiyyay amar ribbi chizkiyya, kol man dekare lechavreh rasha, nachtin leh laggehinnam. venachtin leh leiloy, bar innun chatzifin deorayyta, dishre leh leinish lemikre lehu rasha.

Hahu gavra, delayit lechavreh, abar ribbi yesa, amar leh kerasha avadt. atyeh lekameh deribbi yehuda, amar leh rasha la kamena leh, ella kerasha, deachze milloy kerasha, vela amena deihu rasha. ata ribbi yehuda, veshail leovada kameh derabbi elazar, amar leh, vadday la itchayyayv. menalan. dichtiv, (Eicha 2) haya Adonai keoyev, vela oyev. dei lav hachi, la ishtear miyyisrael gizin bealma. kegavvna da, (Eicha 2) hayta kealmana, vela almana, kealmana deazil balah leivra deyamma, umechakkat leh.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, umehacha mashma, mehatam mashma, dehu ikara decholla, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam. kemare adam, vela mare adam. amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegomer, ketappuach vela tappuach. ketappuach: demitparsha bigvavnoy, uvigvavnin itachada milla. amar rabbi yehuda, illu la atena hacha ella lemishma millin illen, dayay.

Tana ketiv, (Zecharya 12:8) vehaya hannichshal bahem bayyom hahu kedavid. kedavid, vela david. kedavid, deamar, (divrei hayamim 1 22:14) vehinne veanyi hachinoti levet Adonai. uchetiv, (Tehillim 86:1) ki ani veevyon ani. vehu malka al malkin hava, vahava kare legarmeh hachi. amar rabbi abba, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu la kera lon kekodesh, ella kodesh mammash, dichtiv kodesh yisrael laAdonai, ubbegin kach kol ochlav yeshamu vegomer.

Tana, amar ribbi yosi, may ka chama kudesha berich hu, lemehav dinin leyisrael, batar eser amiran. ella hachi tanenan, missitra (84 amud alef) digvura, ityeyhivat orayyta leyisrael. begine kach, baa lemetan shelama benayyhu, begin deorayyta tehe netira mikkol sitroy. deamar rabbi abba amar rabbi yitzchak, let alma mitkayyeyma, ella al dina, deilmale dina, la mitkayyeyma. ubbegin kach alma bedina itbere, veitkayyaym.

Tana, ribbi abba, ketiv (Yirmeyahu 21:12) dinu labboker mishpat. vechi labboker, velav bechol yoma. ella labboker, ad la yechlun dayyaynin, vela yishtun, dechol man dedain dina batar deachal veshata, lav dina dikshot hu, dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:26) lo tochlu al haddam. may al haddam. azhara ledayyayne, dela yechlun ad dedayyne dina, dechol man dedain dina batar deachil veshate, keillu chiyyev dama dechavreh leachara, deha dameh mammash yahiv leachara. hay bemamona, kol shekken bedini nefashot, devau dayyayne leistammera, dela lemedan dina ella kodem deachlu veshatu, veal da ketiv dinu labboker mishpat uchetiv, (yirmeya 19) ani Adonai ose chesed umishpat utzedaka baaretz ki veelle chafatzti neum Adonai.

Tanya, amar ribbi yehuda, man dimshakker bedina, meshakker betikkune malka. man tikkune malka. innun deittemar, dichtiv ose chesed mishpat utzedaka baaretz. uchetiv ki veelle chafatzti neum Adonai. vecholla hay behay talya. (nusach acher vahalo behay talya) ribbi yosi amar, illen innun tikkune kurseyay, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 16:5) vehuchan bachesed
742: Kan matchil aydarea demashkena tanya beraza derazin, resha demalka, ittakkan bechesed uvigvura. behay resha, talyayn shaare, nimin al nimin, deinnun kol meshichuta demitachadan behu illae vetattae. mare demarin, mare dikshot, mare demitkela, mare divava, mare dilala, mare dedina, mare derachame, vetaame orayyta, veraze orayyta dachyayn, misavan, kullehu ikrun shaare demalka, kelomar meshichuta deitmeshach mimmalka kaddisha, vecholla nachit meattika setimaa. (kaddisha)

Mitzcha demalka, pekiduta dechayyavayya, kad itpakkedan beovadayyhu, vechad itgalleyayn chovayyhu, keden ikre mitzcha demalka. kelomar, gevura ittakkaf bedinoy, veitpashshat besitroy, veda ishtane mimmitzcha deattika kaddisha, deikre ratzon.

Ayynin demalka, ashgachuta decholla, ashgachuta deillain vetattain, vechol innun mare ashgachuta hachi ikrun. beayynin, gavvnin itachadan, veinnun gavvnin ikrun, kol innun mare ashgachuta demalka, kol chad kefum archeh, vechullehu gavvnin deena ikrun. kema deitchaze ashgachuta demalka, hachi gavvnin mitarin.

Gevine deayynin, ikrun, atar deyahavin ashgachuta, lechullehu gavvnin mare ashgachuta. hane gevinin legabbe diltatta, gevinin leashgachuta mehahu nahara denagid venafik, atar leitmashshecha mehahu nahara, leistachaa bechivvavra deattika, mechalava denagid meima. dechad gevura mitpashsheta, veayynin melahatan begavevn sumaka, nahir attika kaddisha chivvara dileh, velahata beimma, veitmalleyay mechalava, veyanka lehane, (lecholla) veistechan kullehu ayynin, behahu chalava deimma, deitnegid venafik tadir. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:12) rochatzot bechalav. bechalav deima, denagid tadira vela pasik.

Chotama demalka kaddisha, tikkuna defartzufa, kad mitpashshetan gevuran, umitachadan kachada, innun chotama demalka kaddisha. veinnun gevuran mechad gevura achidan venafkin. vechad dinin mitarin, venafkin missitrayyhu, la mitbasseman, ella bitnana demadbecha. ucheden ketiv, (Bereshit 8:21) vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach. shane chotama deattika, dela itzterich, dechotama deattika, orech appayim becholla ikre, vehahu nehiru dechachmeta setimaa, ikre chotama dileh. vehayeynu tehilla, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:9) utehillati echotam lach. veal da ittear david malka, (Tehillim 145:1) tehilla ledavid vegomer.

Udenin demalka, kad raava ishtechach, veima yanka, unehiru deattika kaddisha itnehir, mitarin nehiru ditren moche, unehiru deabba veima, kol innun deikrun moche demalka, umitlahatin kachada. vechad mitlahatan kachada, ikrun azne Adonai. deha itkabbilat tzelotehon deyisrael. ucheden itaruta letav ulevish, uveitaruta da, mitarin mare degadpin, denatlin kalin dealma, vechullehu ikrun azne Adonai.

Anpoy demalka, nehiru deabba veimma, veitpashshetuta dilhon, denaharin vesacharin, velahatin behay resha demalka. ucheden sahaduta isittehad bemalka (nusach acher bemalka demalka) minnayyhu. diyyukena demalka, yakkiruta mikkolla. merisha share chesed illaa, ugevura. unehiru deabba veimma itpelag, nehiru deabba bitlat nehorin, veima bitren, ha chamishsha. chesed ugevura bechad nehora, ha shita. levatar, itattar chesed, veitlehit (veitnehir) bitren nehorin deitnehir veinnun temanyay. (nusach acher levatar 680) ugevura, itnehir bechad, ha tisha. vechad mitchabberan kullehu nehorin kachada, ikrun diyyukena demalka, ucheden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina vegomer.

Shifvavn demalka, hachi tana, kad itnehir nehiru deabba, nahir bitlat nehorin. mechad nehora, nahir chesed illaa. mechad nehora, itnehir nehiru deikre mocha demalka. vechad nehora, hava tale, ad deitnehir nehiru deima. vechad itnehir itnehir bechamesh nehorin.
Bemay itnehir, mechad shevila detamir veganiz,
743: Deitdabbak beh abba, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:7) nativ lo yedao ayit vegomer. kema deitdabbak dechura benukeva, veitabberat, veolidat, veappikat chamesh nehorin. (davar acher meinnun chamesh) umeinnun chamesh nehorin, itgelifu chamshin tarin, dinhorin saggiin. chamshin innun, lokovlehon, 49 panim tahor, 49 panim tame, beorayyta, ishtear chad, vehay chad itnehir becholla, vehahu deabba, hava tale. kad mitchabberan kachada, umityayshshevan bemalka, ikrun shifvavn demalka. uvegini kach, gazar millin dikshot.

Ufuma, behu talyay, petichuta defuma. may puma. ella daat ganiz befuma demalka, deikre tiferet. peshituta detiferet, dechol otzarin vechol gevavnin itachadan beh. dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:4) uvedaat chadarim yimmalu. vehahu daat, hu ganiz, befuma demalka. umalyay kol iddarin veachsadrain. vechad ittear nehiru deveh venafik, keden ikre pe Adonai. veshifvavn deinnun teren nehorin meabba umeimma, beshaata deitaran behahi nehiru dedaat, mitchabberan kachada, umillin itgezaru bikshot, bechachma bitvuna uvedaat. ucheden, kol millin dekudesha berich hu, beillen itgezaru.

Naharin telat illen, veayylin bego lego, veitattaru bechad. vechad mitchabberan beittura chad, keden (sefer acher vechad mitchabberan telat illen beittura chad veayylin bego lego vaataataren bechad keden) ikrun (Shir HaShirim Adonai:16) chikko mamtakkim. veinnun chech demalka, veikrun, metika demalka. veal hay ketiv, (tehillim la) taamu ureu ki tov Adonai. uvehay chech, talyayn kol innun shelitin vehuremanin demalka, dichtiv, (Tehillim 33:6) uveruach piv kol tzevaam.

Behay chech shelemuta decholla ishtechach. uvegine kach, kol atvavn deinnun behay atar shelemuta itchazyay behu. (Vayikra 229 amud bet) 84, 1, (54) nehiru deattika kaddisha setimaa dechol setimin. 8, nehiru dechachmeta, dela ishtechach vela itiddevak dichtiv, (Iyov 28:13) lo yada enosh erkah. Adonai, nehiru deimma, denahir venagid venafik, umashke lecholla, veyanka livnin, ad demate hahu revut, umalle latztzaddik, veihu itketar benukeba tattaa, veitbarcha mineh, vela mitparshin da min da. chivvavr miggo sumak, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:6) har hammor givat hallevona. 70, nehiru de anpin, deitzanu mehay rucha, denafik min puma, keden 70 shemahan dekudesha berich hu. lokovlehon beara, (Bereshit 46:27) kol hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa mitzrayma shivim. deha yaakov ilana beara, veinnun 70 nefesh, 70 anpin.

Meillen atvavn, nehirin arba acharanin. me nahir gimel, deihi agar tav letzaddikayyay, deikre gemul, veal da ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. mech nahir yod, dehi chachma, kolla astim beYod, deihi setima mikkol sitroy, ubbegin kach, lo ishtechach, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:13) velo timmatze beeretz hachayyim. meAdonai, nahir kaf. deihu nehiru umeshach revut, deitterak meimma, lehahu atar deitkere keren, veikre keren hayyovel. veda malchut david. uvegin kach, let meshicha, ella beraza dechaf.

100 Me nahir 100, kema de shivin, kach 100 mea, deinnun shelimu, vehachi hu, uvegin kach, behay chech shelimu decholla. (davar acher shelama decholla) vechol man deyada raza da, veizdehar beh, zakkaa chulakeh.

Gufa demalka, itpashshetuta detiferet, degvavnin beh mitchabberan. deroin demalka, nehiru dechesed ugevura. uvegin kach yamin usemol. meoy bedaat ittaknan, ayel beresha, ittakkan veitpashshat lego, uvego gufa.

Shokin itachadan bitren nehorin, veinnun teren nehorin mammash. shokin uteren kulleyayn. kullehu (sefer acher talyayn umitchabberan) mitchabberan beatar chad, detamman itkenash kol revut, vechol mishcha degufa. umittamman, sharyayn kol hahu revut, laatar deitkere yesod olam. yesod, mehahu atar deikre olam. uman ihu. netzach vehod, veal ken, Adonai tzevaot shemo berich hu berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin.
Kol hane tikkunin, atyayn leitchabbera bechad, ad dechol revut kudsha, natil kolla hay yesod, veashde lenukeba, umitbarcha mineh. ematay mitbarcha
744: Mineh. beshaata deittakkanu dinin diltatta. vechad dinin mittaknin letatta, mittaknin leella, vechol tikkunin demalka, bechedvavta, bishlimu, deinnun shema kaddisha, vahava kolla chad. ucheden hu shari begavvavyyhu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 82:1) elohim nitztzav beadat el bekerev elohim yishfot.

Vechad dinin la mittaknan letatta, kivyachol hachi leella. dechol tikkunin la mityashsheran hachi, deha ima istalakat meal benin, uvenin la yanke, deha yesod la ashde benukeba, vechol dinin mitarin, vechivya takkifa shalta. kivyachol, tikkuni malka al dina istalaku, dechevan dehay nukeba la mitbarcha, vetzadik la natil. vechivya takkifa shalta. vavy lealma deyanka minnayyhu.

Amar ribbi elazar, kol hani tikkunin, abba galle lon, begin dela yeul bechisufa lealma deate. hasheta amay itzterichu leitgallaa. amar leh ribbi abba, hahu daana katavna mibbutzina kaddisha, amena (katebaveh) legabbe chavrayya, deha innun yadin millin, veha itzterich leminda, dichtiv, (Shemot 10:2) vidatem ki ani Adonai. uchetiv (Shemot 29:46) veyadu ki ani Adonai. begin deityayshshevan millin. belibbana. umikkan ulehala, setimin millin begavvavn. zakkaa chulakana behay alma, uvealma deate, deha ad kean butzina kaddisha itattar, bemillin divgavvavn.

Ta chaze, ana chazena leh bechelma, veshailna kameh derabbi shimon, ha olifna kameh demar, 10 deihi chachma, vehachi hu vadday. Adonai amay ihu bina. amar li, ta chaze, ha ketiv (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. man hu nahar deyotze meeden da bina. ubbegin kach hahu nahar, 10 satim begavveh. veyud pashit nahara da mikkol sitroy. veda hi Adonai, begin kach hu 15. levatar appikat ben techotah deihu 6, kegavvna da Adonai. levatar olidat veappikat hay ben, veshavye lekammah, uvegin kach Yahu, deha 6 lekammah yativ, leyanka leh. veal kach tanenan bematnita dilan, Adonai 4 havat, middeitchabbar dechura immah itabberat mechad ben, veikre Adonai. levatar olidat veappikat 6 hahu ben, vekaim lekammah. veal hay ketiv, venahar yotze meeden, minneh nafik vadday, lehashekot et haggan, leyanka leh.

Havina achid bideh, (nusach acher beh) venashik bidoy. ana behay idduna ittearna, bache vechayich, vahavu telata yomin dela achilna midi. chad mechedvavta, vechad dela zachena lemechome leh zimna achara. veim kol da, beh itkasharna tadira. deha kad nehira li shemateta, chamena diyyukeneh, deittear kammay, zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha. (ad kan haayderaa).

(Shemot 23:13) uvechol asher amarti alechem tishshameru vegomer. may tishshameru, tishmoru mibbae leh. ella tishshameru vadday, may asher amarti alechem, kelomar deagzimit lechon al memar pulechani. tishshameru, dela yamte alechon shum bish. tishshameru mehahi shemira unetura dili bilvad. veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru, lo tazkiru kema deokimna. davar acher veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru, kelomar, lo tesabbevun, detippelun beni amamya beara achara. vikuyam bechu ma dichtiv, (Devarim 28:36) veavadta sham elohim acherim vegomer.

Davar acher uvechol asher amarti alechem tishshameru. rabbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 81:9) shema ammi veaida bach vegomer, lo yihye vecha el zar vegomer. anochi Adonai elohecha hammaalcha meeretz mitzrayim vegomer. hane karan, amaran david beruach kudesha, veit leistakkol behu. shema ammi bechamma atrin azhara orayyta lebar nash. bechamma atrin kudesha berich hu azhir beh bevar nash. vecholla letoalta devar nash. begin deyintar pikkude orayyta, dechol man
745: Deyintar arche deorayyta, veishtaddal bah, keman deishtaddal bishma kaddisha.

Detanenan, orayyta kolla shema dekudesha berich hu. uman demishtaddal bah, keman demishtaddal bishma kaddisha. begin deorayyta kolla, chad shema kaddisha hu. shema illaa, shema dechalil kol shemahan. uman degara ot chad minah, keillu avid pegimuta bishma kaddisha. tana, veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru, lo tosif al orayyta, vela tigra minnah. rabbi chiyyay amar, veshem elohim acherim, da man deyitasak besifrin acharanin, dela missitra deorayyta. la yishshama al picha, deasur afillu leadkera lon, ulemelaf minnayyhu taama, kol shekken al orayyta.

Rabbi yehuda matne hachi, may taama ketiv veshem elohim acherim, vesamich leh et chag hammatztzot tishmor. ella, man dela natir hay, keman dela natir mehemnuta dekudesha berich hu. may taama. mishshum deveh achida milla. amar rabbi yitzchak, vechen bechol shear zimnin vechaggin, deha kullehu achidan bishma kaddisha illaa. veal da taninan, may dichtiv shalosh peamim bashshana, mishshum divhu talya mehemnuta.

Yerae kol zechurecha, amay kol zechurecha. (Vayikra 165 amud bet) amar ribbi elazar kol zechurecha mammash. begin denatlin birkata, mimmabbua denachala. mikkan tanenan, kol bar yisrael deitgezar, bae leitchazaa kame malka kaddisha, begin denatil birkata, mimmabbua denachala. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 16:17) kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach. uchetiv el pene (Bereshit 2 amud alef) haadon Adonai, kema deokimna, demittamman merikan birkan, venatlin birkata. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, mikkol shear ammin.

Zimna chada, seliku yisrael lemechag chagga, veitarvu ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bahadayyhu, vehahu shatta la ishtechach birkata bealma. atu shaillu lerav hamenuna sava, amar lehu, chametun simana bekadmita behay. amar leh, simana chamenan, dechad tavna mehatam, kol archin astimu mimmayya, vaanana, vachashocha ishtechach, dela yachlin lemehach kol innun desaliku letamman. veod, beshaata dealana leitchazaa appe shemaya itchashshachu veitregizu. (itregish bechema) amar lehu, vadday o it benayychu bene nasha dela itgezaru, o ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot seliku bahadayychu. deha la itbarchan behahi shaata, bar meinnun yisrael deitgezaru. uvehay at kaddisha mistakkel kudesha berich hu, uvarich lon.
