Leshatta achara seliku, useliku innun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deitarvu bahadayyhu, kad havo achlin karbenayyay, vahavu chaddan. vechamu leinun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, detafsan bekuterayyhu lekutera dechotala. ashgachu behu decholla mevarchin, veinnun la berichu. atu veamru milla leve dina, atu veshaillu lon, amru, hay daachaltun, chulaka dilchon, man kurebana hava. la hava bidayyhu. badku veashkachu deinnun ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, vekatlu lon. amru, berich rachamana desheziv leammeh, devadday let bircheta sharya, ella beyisrael, zara kaddisha, beni mehemnuta, bene keshot. vehahi shatta ishtechach bircheta bealma, bishlimu. patchu veamru, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha vegomer.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, bizchut yisrael gezirin, itkenau sanehon techotehon, veyarte achasantehon. ta chaze ma ketiv, (Shemot la) yerae kol zechurecha. uchetiv batreh, ki orish goyim mippanycha vehirchavti et gevulecha. dekudesha berich hu akar diyyurin meatrayyhu, veativ diyyurin, leatrayyhu. uvegini kach yerae kol zechurecha et pene haadon Adonai. rabbi yehuda amar, haadon. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 10:33) hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot mesaef pura vegomer, veyatza choter vegomer, vecholla chad, meakker diyyurin veativ diyyurin. ribbi yitzchak amar, it adon, veit adon, vecholla bechad talya.
Rabbi yehuda amar, adonay: alef dalet nun yod, kudesha berich hu ikre,
746: Vehahu deikre, kema deihu ketiv. uman hu. rabbi yosi omer, (Yechezkel 1:1) marot elohim. marat ketiv. umahu marat. shelimu decholla, yod hei vav hei. (nusach acher marot ihu 1 kulei) marat lemay ihu alef dalet nun yod, hay ikre kichtavo, vehay la ikre kichtavo, uvegine kach ikre behay, veal kach marat elohim ketiv.

Rabbi yehuda amar, lezimnin, illain ikrun bishma detattain. ulezimna, tattain ikrun bishma deillain. haadon Adonai, bishma illaa adonay hu. veha okimna mille. uvigvavnin saggiin itparshan mille, vecholla chad. berich rachamana berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin.

(Shemot 23:20) hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha vegomer. rabbi yitzchak patach, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu vegomer amra keneset yisrael, yishshakeni minneshikot pihu. may taama yishshakeni, yeehaveni mibbae leh, amay yishshakeni. ella hachi tanenan, may neshikot adbekuta derucha berucha. divgini kach neshika bappe, deha puma afkuta umekora derucha hu, veal da neshikin befuma, bachavivuta, vedavkin rucha berucha, dela mitparshan da min da.

Veal da man denafik nishmateh binshika, mitdebak berucha achara. berucha dela mitperash minneh. vehayeynu ikre neshika. veal da amra keneset yisrael, yishshakeni minneshikot pihu, leadbeka rucha berucha, dela yitperish da min da.

Ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, may bae hacha yayin, veha ketiv (Yeshayahu 28:7) vegam elle beyayin shagu vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 10:9) yayin veshechar al tesht atta uvanecha, may taama hacha yayin. rabbi chiyyay amar, miyyenah deorayyta. rabbi chizkiyya amar, da dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:15) veyayin yesammach levav enosh, veal da ketiv, ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, lechedvavta delibba. miyyayin, dechadde li yattir mikkolla.

Rabbi yehuda amar, ketiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel veyissa et kolo vayyevch, amay ka bacha. ella beitdabbekuta derucha bah, la yachil libba lemisbal, uvacha. vei tema, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 33:4) vayyishshakehu vayyivku. tanenan, amay nakud vayyishshakehu, ella dela itdabbak beh rucha kelal, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 27:6) venatarot neshikot sone. may venatarot neshikot sone. ella man denashik bachavivuta, mitdavak rucheh berucheh, bidvekuta dachavivuta uman dela nashik bachavivuta, lav bidvekuta hu, ella venatarot. may natarot. gassuta, dela davik rucheh behahu neshika. vela itdabbak beh kelal. uvegine kach ketiv, yishshakeni minneshikot pihu, dehu devekuta rucha berucha.

Tana, kol zimna dekudesha berich hu azil beyisrael, kivyachol itdabbak rucha berucha, veal da ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai, bechol innun gavvne devekuta, vela mitparsha da min da. beshaata deittemar hinne anochi soleach malach lefanecha, yada moshe difrishuta hu. amar (Shemot 33:15) im en panecha holchim al taalenu mizze.

Rabbi abba amar, ma ketiv leella min da, (Shemot la) reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo. may ka mayyre. ella dela learva milla tattaa beillaa, dela yanka sitra dilvar, missitra penimaa. ma ben hay lehay. da dilvar, missitra dimsaava. veda dilgo, besitra kaddisha. man immo. da keneset yisrael, deitkere em. bachalev immo, dela yanik mehay sitra, man dela itzterich.
Vehacha ketiv, hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha. amar moshe, ha kabbilna bitchona minach, dela titperash minan, vadday im en panycha holchim al taalenu mizze. uvamme yivvada efo vegomer.
Amar rabbi elazar, milla da la kaamar kudesha berich hu ella birchimuta deyisrael, uleitpayyeysa bahadayyhu. lemalka dehava bae lemezal im bereh. vela bae leshavka leh. ata bereh,
747: Umistafe lemibbae leh lemalka deyezil bahadeh. akdim malka veamar, ha ligyon pelan yezil bahadach, lemintar lach bearcha. levatar amar istammar lach minneh, (bearcha) deha la gevar shelim hu. amar bereh, i hachi, o ana otiv hacha, o at tezzil immi, vela itperash minach. kach kudesha berich hu, bekadmita amar, hinne anochi soleach malach lefanecha lishmarcha baddarech. ulevatar amar hishshamer mippanav vegomer, beh shaata amar moshe, im en panecha holchim vegomer.

Ata rabbi shimon, ashkach lehu behay. amar, elazar beri shappir kaamart. aval ta chaze, baatar da la amar moshe midi, vela ativ milla lokovle. may taama. mishshum dehacha la ishtechach perishuta minneh. veha okimna milla da, legabbe chavrayyay. veit dematne ippecha vela hachi pershuha kadmae. vechad yistakkelun mille kolla shappir, vecholla bechad milla amre taamayyhu.

Ematay ativ moshe. bezimna deamar, (Shemot 33:2) veshalachti lefanecha malach. uchetiv ki yelech malachi lefanecha, satam vela parish milla. veal da ketiv, hacha, ki im shamoa tishma bekolo veasita kol asher adabber. asher adabber davka uchetiv veayavti et oyvecha vetzarti et tzorarecha, vecholla beh talya.

Ribbi yehuda amar, i tema detarvavyyhu malach mammash, moshe la ativ alayyhu, dela chama ducheta. ematay ativ. bezimna dichtiv im en panycha holchim vegomer. amar ribbi shimon, kelal decholla, moshe la baa malacha. deha ketiv (Shemot la) vayyomer im na matzati chen beenecha adonay yelech na adonay bekirbenu.

Amar ribbi yehuda, hay deamar ribbi abba, dichtiv lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo, bachalev haem mibbae leh, may immo. vei tema, keneset yisrael immo desitra dimsoova, lav hachi, deha shemana deamar ribbi shimon, keneset yisrael imma kaddisha bechulakeh deyisrael itachada, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo.

Amar ribbi shimon, shappir kaamart. veha derabbi abba shappir vecholla da beda talya. ta chazi, ima itachada lehu leella, lesitra da ulesitra da, uteren innun, chada limina, vachada lismala. uvegine kach, minnehon limina, uminnehon lismala. vechullehu talyayn behay em, imma kaddisha, veitachadan bah.

Ematay itachadan bah. beshaata dehay em yanka missitra achara, umikdesha isteav, vechivya takkifa shari leitgallaa, keden gadya yanka mechalava deimmeh, vedinin mitarin. veal da, yisrael kaddemin veeytan bikkurim, uveshaata demayytin lehu, bayayn lememar ulemiftach beh belavan, devaa becharshoy illen, leshalletaa beyaakov, uvezara kaddisha, vela ityeyhivu bideh, vela itmasseran yisrael lesitra da. veal da ketiv, reshit bikkure admatcha vegomer, lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo. vela yanka hahu sitra, mechalava deimmeh, deha la yisteav makdesha, vedinin la mitarin.

Begine kach, la yechul bisra bechalava kol zara kaddisha, vechol man deate missetar da, dela yahiv ducheta, leman dela itzterich, deha beovada talya milleta, beovada diltatta, leatara leella. zakkain innun yisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, demarehon kare alayyhu, (Devarim 14:2) uvecha bachar Adonai lihyot lo leam segulla. uchetiv (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha (vecholla chad mila) uchetiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem vegomer.

Ta chazi, beshaata deyisrael la itkesharu ovadayyhu, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 3:12) ammi nogsav meolel venashim mashlu vo. mashlu vo dayyka, veha okimna mille beraza desifra deshlomo malka. vehachi ashkechan beh. tu ashkechan, dechol man deachil hay mechla deitchabbar kachada. (o) beshaata chada, o bisudata chada. arbein yomin itchazya gadya mekullasa biklippoy, legabbe innun dilella, vesiyyata mesaava
748: Mitkarvin bahadeh, vegarim leatara dinin bealma, dinin dela kaddishin.

Vei olid bar beinnun yomin, ozfin leh nishmeta, missitra achara, dela itztericha. uchetiv (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim vegomer. ate leistaava, mesaavin leh vadday. dichtiv, (Vayikra 11:44) venitmetem bam, chaser 1, mesoovuta atima mikkolla, delet reshu leitdakkea hachi, kishar zine dimsoovuta demitdakkin. vetu, demistafe mechevan bishan, deha beenayyhu gadya ishtechach, veyachil leattezka, deha tzulma devar nash itavar minneh.

Rabbi yesa, share lemechal letarnegola bigvina o bechalava. amar ribbi shimon asir lach dela yahiv inish pitcha lezinin bishin. lech lech amrin nezira, sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav. vadday asir lach hu, dechumera it beh, kivira lashshechita. uman deshare hay, ma ketiv (Amos 2:12) vattashku et hannezirim yayin, man deshare hay, kemaan deshare hay. uchetiv (Devarim 14:3) lo tochal kol toeva, kol, leachlala kolla.

Tana, bema zachu daniyel chananya mishael vaazarya, deishtezivu meinnun nisyone, ella begin dela istaavu bemechlehon. amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv (Daniel 1:8) vayyasem daniyel al libbo asher la yitgaal befat bag hammelech vegomer. vetana bistima dematnitin, mechla dehahu rasha, bisra bechalava hava ugevina im bisra, bar mechlan acharanin, veda salik leh befatoreh, bechol yoma.

Vedaniyel deistammar mehay, kad ramu yateh leguva dearyayvavta, ishtelim betzulema demareh, vela shane (Bereshit 191 amud alef) tzulemeh letzulema achara, veal da dachalu aryayvavta minneh, vela chabbeluhu. vehahu rasha, beshaata demalchuta itade minneh, (Daniel 4:20) veim chevat bara hava madoreh, ade tzulema deanpoy minneh, umehahu yoma, la itchaze tzulemeh, tzulema devar nash. vechol beira deate, itchaze leh, tzulema dezineh, venukeveh, vahavu atyayn aleh kullehu, uvechamma zimnin havo achlin leh chevat bara, bar deitgezar hay onsha aleh, begin dichtiv, (Chavakuk 1:10) vehu bammelachim yitkallas, begin kach, kolla yitkallesu beh, kol hahu zimna.

Ta chazi, ma ketiv, (Daniel 1:13) ulemiktzat yamim asara nira marehen tov mikkol hayeladim haochlim et pat bag hammelech. nira marehen tov, detzulema demarehon la adiu minnehon, umeacharine adiu. man garim hay. begin dela itgaalu begiule mechlehon. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dichtiv behu, veanshe kodesh tihyun li.

(Shemot 24:1) veel moshe amar ale el Adonai vegomer. veel moshe amar, (131 amud alef) man amar. da shechinta. ale el Adonai, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim vegomer. (sefer acher Vayikra elav Adonai) amay kol da, lekayyeyma immehon kayyaym, begin deha itperau, ma dela nafku hachi mimmitzrayim, deitgezaru, vela itperau, (40 amud alef) vehacha ha itperau, vealu bivrit kayyayma, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:25) sham sam lo chok umishpat. dayyka vesham nissahu, behay at kaddisha, deitgalyay behu, vehacha itkayyaym behu, al yeda demoshe gezira dekayyayma, dichtiv, vayyikkach moshe et haddam vayyizrok al haam vegomer.

Amar ribbi yitzchak may dichtiv, vachatzi haddam zarak al hammizbeach, bammizbeach la ketiv, ella al hammizbeach dayyka. vehishtachavitem merachok, mahu merachok. kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li. uchetiv, (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok. tane ribbi abba, dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, uveh shaata, zachu yisrael yattir bechulaka kaddisha, vegazru kayyayma kaddisha bekudesha berich hu.

Veel moshe amar ale el Adonai. may tama. amra leh shechinta, istelik leella, deha ana veyisrael, nishtattef kachada bishlemuta al yedach, ma dela hava ad hacha. ma ketiv vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam vegomer, palag leh litren. chatzi haddam zarak al haam, vachatzi haddam zarak
749: Al hammizbeach, kema deokimna. uchetiv, hinni dam habberit asher karat Adonai immachem. vayyasem baagganot, baagganat ketiv, chaser vav. kema dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:3) sharrech agan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg.

(Shemot 24:2) veniggash moshe levaddo el Adonai, zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dehu bilchodoy, zacha lema dela zacha bar nash achara. yisrael zachu hasheta, ma dela zachu ad hahi shaata. vehahi shaata, itkeyyaymu, bekiyyuma illaa kaddisha. uvehahu shaata itbassaru lemeheve benayyhu makdesha, kema deat amer, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham.

(Shemot 24:10) vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach, (Shir HaShirim 7:8) zot komatech damta letamar vegomer, kamma chaviva keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, dela mitparsha minnih, kehay tamar, dela parish dechar min nukeba lealmin, vela (37 amud bet) salik, da bela da. kach keneset yisrael, la mitparsha mekudesha berich hu.

Ta chazi, beshaata denadav vaavihu chamu, veshivin savin. ma ketiv behu. vayyiru et elohe yisrael. deitgele alayyhu shechinta. rabbi yehuda verabbi yosi amre, et dayyka. veda et, hu merachok. et leachlela ma di begavveh.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, veha ketiv (Yechezkel 10:20) hi hachayya asher raiti tachat elohe yisrael binhar kevar, man chayya da. amar ribbi yosi amar rabbi chiyyay, chayya zuteratti. vechi it chayya zuteratti, in. chayya zuteratti, vechayya illaa. vechayya zutera (Bereshit 11 amud bet) dezutarti.

Vayyiru et elohe yisrael, dayyka, kema daamena. vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir, kechezu even tava, dezammin kudesha berich hu lemivne makdesha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:11) vysadtich bassappirim.

(Shemot 24:1) veel atzile bene yisrael, da nadav vaavihu. lo shalach yado, desalik lon levatar zimna, vela itanashu hacha. rabbi yosi amar, milla da, lishvacha dilhon, dichtiv vayyochlu vayyishtu dezanu enehon, minnehiru da. rabbi yehuda amar, achila vaddait achlu, vezanu garmayyhu, vehacha itkesharu leella, i la desatu orchayyhu levatar, kema deokimna.

Amar rabbi elazar, vaafillu yisrael, behahi shaata itkesharu, veitkashsharat behu shechinta. veda kayyayma, veorayyta kolla, bechad zimna hava. veyisrael kehahi shaata la chamu lealmin. ulezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu leitgallaa al benoy, ulemechome kolla yekara dileh ena beena, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 52:8) ki ayin beayin yiru beshuv Adonai tziyyon. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 40:Adonai) vnigla kevod Adonai vrau chol basar yachdav vegomer.
750: (Devarim lak) ki chelek Adonai ammo. veyahav lishar ammin shuletanin ravrevan memanan alayyhu, vehu natil lechulakeh yisrael.

Rabbi shimon patach, (Shir HaShirim 6:10) mi zot hannishkafa kemo shachar yafa challevana bara kachamma ayuma kannidgalot. mi zot, raza ditren almin mitchabberan kachada, veda hu olam veolam. mi: ha (Bereshit 31 amud alef) okimna darga illaa leella, sheruta dekayyeyma bishelta, veikre mi, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi vara elle. zot: darga tattaa letatta, alma tattaa. vetarvavyyhu, teren almin bechibbura chada, bekishshura chada kachada.

Hannishkafa: kad mitchabberan tarvavyyhu kachada. kemo shachar: kad bayay shacharuta leanhara ulevatar itnehir kesihara, kad (kanish) batash bah nehiru deshimsha. ulevatar keshimsha, kad kayyeyma sihara bishlimu. ayuma: takkifa, leaggana al kolla. deha kedin it lah shelimu utekifu, lemebad chela.

Venatla chela mealma illaa, al yeda deyaakov shelema, dechibber lon kachada. chibber lon kachada leella. vechibber lon kachada letatta. umittamman nafku, teresar shevatin kaddishin, kegavvna dilella. yaakov dehava shelim, ail rechimu bitren almin, kema deokimna. shear bene nasha deavdin keden megallin eryayn leella vetatta, garim devavu bitren almin, vegarim piruda, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 18:18) veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror, deitavedu mare devavu da leda.

Vei tema (Bereshit 30:1) vattekanne rachel baachotah. hachi hu vadday deha alma tattaa, kol tiuvete lav ihu, ella begin lemeheve kegavvna dealma illaa, ulemerat duchetaha. beducheta achara kinat sofrim asgiat chachmeta, vehacha kinat sofrin, begin deit (137 amud bet) sefer vesefer, asgiu meshichu dechachmeta (illaa) legabbayyhu. (nusach acher veal da yaakov ashlim kulei)

Veim kol da, afillu yaakov la ashlim legabbayyhu kadka chaze. shear bene alma, garmin devavu, vegarmin piruda, umegallin eryayn decholla, eryayn deella vetatta. uveraza da it raza deeryayn, eryayn deima uverata, vecholla beraza chada. mi zot itkerun achtan, begin deinnun beachva uvirchimu, uvechibbura diruta. veikrun ima uverata. man degalle arayaython, let leh chulaka lealma deate, velet leh chulaka bimhemanuta.
Ta chaze, ki yaakov bachar lo yah, raza illaa leella. kevan deashlim, veikre yisrael, keden lisgullato, natil kolla bechol sitrin, venatil leella venatil letatta, veishtelim becholla.

Amar ribbi shimon, ha tanenan, dechad bara kudesha berich hu alma, gelif biglifoy deraze mehemnuta, go tehirin berazin illain, vegalif leella vegalif letatta, vecholla beraza chada, beraza degilufe dishma kaddisha Adonai, deshalit beatvoy ella vetatta. uveraza da ishtachlalu almin, alma illaa vealma tattaa.

Alma illaa ishtachlal beraza deat 10, nekuda illaa kadmaa, denafka miggo desatim veganiz dela yedia, vela kayyeyma leminda, vela ityeyda kelal, seliku deraza deen sof, umiggo setimu da, nahir nehiru chad dakik vesatim, kalil begavveh kelala dechol nehorin. uvehahu nehiru satim, batash beh man dela batash. nahir beh man dela nahir. ucheden, appik chad nehiru, deihu idduna leidduna, leishtashea, leitganneza nehiru dakik, vesatim bego hahu nehiru.

Vehahu nehiru deihu idduna leidduna, satim, itkayyaymu (nusach acher aterakeymev) veishtachlalu beh shit reshimin, dela yedian, bar lehahu nehora dakik kad al leitganneza, idduna beidduna nahir binhiru.

Vehay nehiru denafak miggo nehiru dakik ihu dechila veemtani vetakkifa yetera, veitpashshat hay veitavid alma chada, denahir lechol almin. alma setima dela yedia kelal, uvegavveh dayyrin shit ribbo elef, deinnun dayyrin vechelin umashyryayn illain.
Vechevan deappik lon veishtachlalu kachada keden
751: Ihu chibbura chada. veinnun raza deat 22, deitchabbar behahu alma setima, (kan chaser) ucheden ketiv, (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah. kad nafik 22, veishtachlal miggo yah, keden yisrael lisgullato.

Shear bene alma, la ityeyhiv lon reshu lesalleka hachi, ella lisgullato, atar denatil vechanish kolla. veda ihu darga letatta, umiggo da, natlin leella, bistimu diru, aval la beitgalya, kema denatil yaakov, hada hu dichtiv veyikchu li teruma.

(Sefer habbahir hasheyych kan siman 3. 80 alav lekamman daf 146 amud alef) (Shemot 25:2) veyikchu li teruma. rabbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam. hay kera ha ukemuha veittemar. aval raza da, ha ukemuha butzina kaddisha, go razin illain.
Darga illaa, deihu raza dealma illaa, ikre mi. darga tattaa, deihu raza dealma tattaa, ikre ma. vetanenan, al tikre ma ella mea, begin dechol dargin illain beashlemutehon hacha innun.

Tu amay ikre ma. ella af al gav dimshichu illaa itmeshach, la itgalya ad deishtelim hacha, deihu atar sofa dechol dargin, sofa deamshachuta decholla, vekayyeyma beitgalya. veaf al gav deitgalya yattir mikkolla, kayyeyma lishela, ma. ma chamit, ma (Bereshit 2 amud bet) yadat, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:15) ki lo reitem kol temuna.

Uvegin kach, ma, rav tuvecha, da ihu yesoda dealma, deikre rav tuv. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 63:7) verav tuv levet yisrael begin dehay ihu rav tuv. or kadmaa, ikre tov setam, vehacha kelilan dechar venukeba kachada. asher tzafanta, dehay itgeniz, kegavvna deor kadmaa, deitgeniz veittammar. paalta: dehacha ihu umanuta decholla, umanuta dechol alma, umanuta denishmatin veruchin.

Beraza da avid kudesha berich hu umanuta dechol alma, veraza da (Bereshit 1:1) bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz. beraza da itavid mashkena veitbene, deihu bediyyukena dealma dilella, uvediyyukena dealma tattaa, hada hu dichtiv veyikchu li teruma. li. teruma. teren dargin, deinnun chad, demitchabberan kachada.

(Shemot 25:2) veyikchu li teruma vegomer. rabbi shimon verabbi elazar veribbi abba veribbi yosi, havo yatve yoma chad, techot ilane, bevikata gabbe yamma deginnosar. amar rabbi shimon, kamma yae tzilla da, dechafya alan miggo ilane, vaanan tzerichin leattera hay atar bemille deorayyta.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Shir HaShirim 3:9) appiryon asa lo hammelech shelomo meatze hallevanon. hay kera ha okimna leh veittemar, aval appiryon, da hechala diltatta, deihu kegavvna dehechala illaa, vekudesha berich hu kara leh ginta deeden, deihu nata leh lahanaateh, vechissufa dileh leishtashea beh go innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, detamman kullehu kayymin ureshimin begavveh. innun nishmatin delet lon gufa behay alma, kullehu sallekin umitatteran tamman, veit lon duchetin lemechome, leitannega go innuga illaa deikre (mikketz 197 amud bet) noam Adonai. vetamman itmalleyayn mikkol kissufin denahare deafarsemona dachya.

Afarsemon: da hechala illaa temira geniza. appiryon: da hechala diltatta, delet beh semach, ad deistemich (nusach acher deitmeshach) miggo hechala illaa. uvegin kach at samech ihu satim bechol sitroy, kegavvna da at 60 (sefer acher mem) setima.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella beshaata desatim veitgeniz begavveh, go (nusach acher nekuda) nehora illaa leella, keden ihi kayyeyma, bediyyukena (nusach acher da) deat samech satim begavvih, veitgeniz beh, lesalleka (ayyen 180 amud alef) leella. uveshaata dehadra veyatva revia al benin letatta leyanka lon, keden ihi kayyeyma bediyyukena deat 40 revia setima lego arba sitrin dealma.
752: Afarsemon, veda hu appiryon. uvaatar teren atvavn 100, kayyeyma 10, beraza divrit, (sefer acher raza divrit deitgeniz begavvivy) deihu zammin lenatla kolla, raza deinnun mea birkan, shitin vearbein. shittin, lokovel shit sitrin, denafke meat 60. arbein, lokovel 4 sitre alma, vecholla ashlimu lemea. veat yod, ihu ashlim leraza demea, kegavvna dilella. veal da, da afarsamon, veda appiryon.

Innun nahare nafkin meafarsemon da, venishmatin illain, delet lon gufa behay alma, yankin mehahu nehiru denafik meinnun nahare afarsemona dachya, umitannege beinnuga da illaa, venishmatin (davar acher 33 desallekin venachtin) deit lon gufa behay alma, sallekin veyankin mehahu nehiru deappiryon da, venachtin. veillen yahave venatle. yahave recha, meinnun ovdin dechashran, demishtaddele behu behay alma. venatle mehahu recha deishtear beh beginta, kema deat amer (Bereshit 27:27) kereach sade asher beracho Adonai, recha deishtear beh behahu chakla. vechullehu kayyme behahi ginta, illen mitannege leella, veillen mitannege letatta.

Asa lo hammelech shelomo, asa lo, legarmeh. vei tema, ha nishmatin detzaddikayya mishtashean beh, veatt amart asa lo. hachi hu vadday. begin dehay appiryon vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayya, kullehu kayyme leishtashea behu kudesha berich hu. hammelech (Bereshit 29 amud alef) shelomo, malka dishlama dileh, veda ihu malka illaa (ha ukemuha) hammelech setam, da malka meshicha. da alma didchura, veda alma denukeba. meatze hallevanon innun ilanin netian, deakar lon kudesha berich hu, veshatil lon baatar achara, veillen ikrun arze levanon, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:16) arze levanon asher nata. vela itbene hay appiryon, vela ishtachlal ella behu.

Tu meatze hallevanon, illen shit yomin divreshit dechol yoma veyoma, mesadder behay appiryon, siddura deitchaze leh: siddura kadmaa. itnegid missitra dimina, or kadmaa deitgeniz, veitnetil missitra dimina, veal behay appiryon al yeda diysoda chad, veavid beh shimmusha. levatar appik hahu appiryon chad diyyukena kegavvna dehay or, veda hu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:3) yehi or vayhi or. kevan deamar yehi or, amay ketiv vayhi or, la itzterich kera lemichtav, ella vayhi ken, mahu vayhi or. ella, dehahu or appik or achara deitchaze leh, veda ihu yoma kadmaa, meinnun atze hallevanon.

Siddura tinyayna: itnegid missitra dismala, perishu demayya, bingidu deeshsha takkifa, veitnetil missitra dismala, veal behay appiryon, veavid beh shimmusha, veafrish ben mayin devistar yemina, uven innun mayin (devistar semala.) levatar appik hahu appiryon, chad diyyukena, kegavvna dileh. veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:7) ben hammayim asher mittachat larakia uven hammayim asher meal larakia vayhi chen. veda ihu yoma tinyayna meinnun atze hallevanon.

Siddura telitaa: itnegid missitra deemtzaita, umissitra dimina, (nusach acher umissitra dismala) chad yoma telitaa, deavid shelama bealma. umittamman itmeshichu evin lecholla, veda avid shimmusha behay appiryon, veappik zina lezineh. zina leovadin saggiin, zina deitchaze leh, vechol deshain vaasavin veilanin bechamma chelin. veishtear diyyukeneh tamman, veappik zina hahu appiryon, kehahu gavvna mammash, veda ihu yoma telitaa, deitkelil miv sitrin, meinnun atze hallevanon.

Siddura reviaa: itnegid veitnehir nehiru deshimsha, leanhara lehay appiryon, go chashuch dileh, veal beh leanhara, vela avid beh shimmusha. ad yoma chamishaa, deappik hay appiryon hahu shimmusha dinhiru, deal beh beyoma reviaa, veappik hahu appiryon behahu gavvna mammash dehahu nehiru, veda ihu yoma reviaa chad meinnun atze hallevanon.
Siddura chamishaa: itnegid chad meshichu, dirchishu
753: Demayya, veavid shimmusha leappaka hahu nehiru, desiddura deyoma reviaa, veavid behay appiryon shimmusha, veappik zinin lezineh, innun deitchaze kehahu gavvna mammash, vehay yoma shimmesh hahu shimmusha, yattir mikkol shear yomin. vecholla talya ad yoma shetitaa, deappik appiryon kol ma dehava ganiz beh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah vegomer. veda ihu yoma chamishaa, chad meinnun atze hallevanon.

Siddura shetitaa: da ihu yoma, deatkin kol hay appiryon, velet leh tikkuna, velet leh tukpa, bar mehay yoma, kad ata hay yoma, ittakkan hay appiryon, bechamma ruchin, bechamma nishmatin, bechamma ulematan shefiran bechezu. innun deitchazun lemetav behechla demalka. uf ihu ittakkan bishfiru kol shear yomin dahavo bekadmita, veatkin lon betiuveta chada, biruta bechedva, tikkuna dilella vetatta.

Keden itkaddash hay appiryon, bekiddushin illain veitattar beitroy, ad desalik bisliku deitra denayycha, veikre shema illaa, shema kaddisha, deihi shabbat. nayycha decholla, tiuveta decholla, devekuta decholla, deella vetatta kachada. ucheden ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:9) appiryon asa lo hammelech shelomo meatze hallevanon.

Amar rabbi shimon, man dezache behahu appiryon, zache becholla, zache lemetav benayycha detzilla dekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:3) betzillo chimmadti veyashavti. vehasheta deyativna betzilla denayycha da, it lan leistakkela dela yatvenan ella betzilla dekudesha berich hu, go hahu appiryon. veit lan leaatara hay atar, beitrin ilain, ad deyitarun ilane dehahu appiryon, lemete alan betzilla achara.

Patach rabbi shimon beresha veamar, veyikchu li teruma meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo tikchu et terumati. veyikchu li, hay man devae leishtaddela bemitzva, uleishtaddela beh bekudesha berich hu, itzterich dela yishtaddal beh berekanayyay uvemaggana, ella itzterich leh levar nash leishtaddela beh kadka yeot kefum cheleh. veha okimna milla da bechamma atre, yeot lemesav bar nash hahu ishtaddeluta dekudesha berich hu. kema deat amer (Devarim 16:17) ish kemattenat yado vegomer.

Vei tema, ha ketiv (Yeshayahu 55:1) lechu shivru veecholu ulechu shivru belo chesef uvelo mechir yayin vechalav, deha ihu bemaggana, (vaashatedalevateh belo kesef) veihu ishtadluta dekudesha berich hu. ella ishtaddeluta deorayyta, kol man devae zache bah. ishtaddeluta dekudesha berich hu leminda leh, kol man devae zache beh, bela agra kelal. aval ishtaddeluta dekudesha berich hu dekayyeyma beovada, asir lenattela leh lemaggana uverekanayyay, begin dela zache behahu ovada kelal, leamshacha aleh rucha dekudesha, ella baagar shelim.

Besifra decharshe, deolif ashmeday lishlomo malka, kol man devae leishtaddela leabera minneh ruach misava, uleachpeyay rucha achara. hahu ovda devae leishtaddela beh, bae lemikne leh baagar shelim, bechol ma deyivun minneh, ben zeer ben rav, begin deruach misava, ihu izdamman tadir bemaggana uverekanayya, veizdevan bela agra, veanis livne nasha lemishre alayyhu, umefatte lon ledayyra immehon, bechamma pittuyin, bechamma archin, sate lon leshavvava diyyvvirih imhon.

Veruach kudesha lav hachi, ella baagar shelim, uveishtaddeluta rav saggi, uveitdakkeuta degarmeh uveitdakkeuta demishkaneh, uviruta delibbeh venafsheh. ulevay deyachil lemirvavch leh, dishavve madoreh immeh. veim kol da deyahach beorach meshar, dela yiste limina velismala, vei lav, miyyad istallak minneh, veitrechak minneh. vela yachil lemirvavch leh kedivkadmeta.
Veal da ketiv, veyikchu li teruma meet kol ish, mehahu deikre ish, deitgabbar al yitzreh. vechol man deitgabbar al yitzreh, ikre ish. asher yiddevennu libbo, may asher yiddevennu libbo. ella.
754: Deyitree beh kudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (tehillim 27) lecha amar libbi. (Tehillim 73:26) tzur levavi. (Mishlei 15:15) vetov lev. (Rut 3:7) vayyitav libbo. kullehu bekudesha berich hu kaamar. uf hacha asher yiddevennu libbo. minneh tikchu et terumati, deha tamman ishtechach velav baatar achara.

Umena yadenan deha kudesha berich hu itree beh, veshavve madoreh beh. kad chamenan diruta dehahu bar nash, (bechedva biruta delibba) lemirdaf uleishtaddela avatreh dekudesha berich hu belibbeh uvenafsheh uviruteh, vadday tamman yadinan desharya beh shechinta. keden baenan lemikne hahu bar nash, bechesef shelim, (uleishtaddela avatreh) leitchabbera bahadeh ulemelaf minneh. veal da kadmae havo amre, ukene lecha chaver, baagar shelim bae lemikne leh, begin lemizke bishchinta. ad hacha bae lemirdaf batar zakkaa ulemikne leh.

Uf hachi, hahu zakkaa bae lemirdaf batar chayyayva, ulemikne leh baagar shelim, begin deyebar minneh hahu zuhama, veyitkafya sitra achara, veyaavid lenafsheh, begin deyitchashshav aleh, keillu hu bara leh. veda ihu shevacha deyistallak beh yekara dekudesha berich hu, yattir mishvacha achara, veistallekuta da yattir mikkolla. may taama. begin deihu garim leachpeya sitra achara, uleistalleka yekara dekudesha berich hu. veal da ketiv beaharon, (Malachi 2:6) verabbim heshiv meavon. uchetiv (Malachi 2:Adonai) beriti hayta itto.

Ta chaze, kol man deachid beyada dechayyayva, (vetav legabbeh) veishtaddal beh, lemishvak archa bisha, ihu istallak bitlat sillukin, ma dela istallak hachi bar nash achara. garim leachpeyay sitra achara. vegarim deistallak kudesha berich hu bikareh. vegarim lekayyeyma kol alma bekiyyumeh leella vetatta. veal hay bar nash ketiv, beriti hayta itto hachayyim vehashshalom. vezache lemechome benin livnoy, vezache behay alma, vezache lealma deate. kol mare dinin, la yachlin lemedan leh, behay alma uvealma deate. al bitresar tare, velet man deyimche bideh. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 112:2-3) gibbor baaretz yihye zaro dor yesharim yevorach. hon vaosher beveto vetzidkato omedet laad. zarach bachoshech or laysharim vegomer.

Beiddara illaa, kayymin telat (sitre) gavvnin. veinnun lahatin go shalhova chada, vehahu shalhova nafka missitra dedarom deihu yemina. veinnun gavvnin mitparshan litlat sitrin. chad salik leella. vechad nachit letatta. vechad deitchaze, veganiz beshaata deshimsha nahir.

Gavvna chada hahu desalik leella, nafka, vehahu gavvna ihu gon chivvavr, yattir mechivvavru achara. veal behahu shalhova veitzteva zeer, vela itzteva, vekayyeyma hahu gon leella al resha dehahu idra. uveshaata deyisrael alin leve kenishta umetzalin tzelothon, kad matan legaal yisrael, vesamchin geula littefilla, keden hay gon chivvavr, istallak al resha deiddara, veitavid leh kitra (dekayyeyma).

Vecharoza nafik veamar, zakkain attun amma kaddisha, deavde tov kameh dekudesha berich hu, veraza da, (Yeshayahu 38:3) vehattov beenecha asiti, (vaychi 258 amud bet) desamich geula lattefilla. begin deha behahi shaatta dematu lithillot leel elyon, desalik hay gon al risha dehahu (127 amud bet) iddara, ittear hay tzaddik, leitchabbera baatar deitzterich, birchimu bachavivu bechedva biruta. vechol shayyfin kullehu, mitchabberan betiuveta chada illen beillen, illain betattain, uvutzinin kullehu naharin umitlahatin, vechulhon kayyma bechibbura chada behay tzaddik deikre tov, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov, veda mechabber lechullehu bechibbura chada. keden kolla bilchishu ella vetatta, binshikin diruta, vekayyeyma milla bechibbura dive iddera.

Kevan dematu lesim shalom, keden avid shimmusha hahu nahar denafik meeden beiddara da, ucheden bayayn kolla lenafka mikkame malka, vela itzterich bar nash, vela achara, leishtakkecha tamman, vela lemishal sheeltin,
755: Ella itzterich leminpal al anpin. may tama. begin dehahi shaatta shaatta deshimmusha have, uvae kol bar nash lemichsaf mikkame mareh, ulechafya anpoy bechissufa saggi, uleachlela nafsheh behahu shimmusha denafshin, deitkelil hahu iddara meella (Rabbi amud bet) umittatta benafshin veruchin. keden gon achara, denachit letatta, kaim veachid beshippule dehay iddara.

Vecharoza nafik vekare veamar, illain vetattain ashidu sahaduta, man ihu deavid nafshan vezakke lechayyayvayya, hahu deitra (sefer acher deitchaze leattera leh, beitra) demalchuta al resheh, hahu deitchaze leaala hasheta kame malka umatronita, deha malka umatronita shaale aleh.

Keden izdaman teren sahadin, meinnun ene Adonai dimshattete bechol alma, vekayymin batar pargoda, vesahadan sahaduta da, veamre, ha anan sahadin al pelanya bar pelanya. zakkaa chulakeh, deha avoy yidkar begineh letav. da ihu avid nafshan letatta, nafshan dechayyayvayya dahavo missitra achara. keden ityakkar kudesha berich hu bechedva shelemata.

Beh shaata izdaman (142 amud bet) chad memana, deihu gizbara al diyyukenin detzaddikayya, beraza deshimmusha deatvavn, deitkere beraza yehodiam, bechitra deshimmusha dishma kaddisha. veramiz kudesha berich hu lehahu memana, veayyte diyyukeneh dehahu bar nash deavid nafshan dechayyayvayya vekaim leh kame malka umatronita.

Vaana ashadna alay shemayya veara divhahi shaata masrin leh hahu diyyukena. deha let lach kol tzaddika behay alma, dela chakik diyyukeneh leella, techot yeda dehahu memana. umasrin bideh 70 maftechan dechol ginzeya demareh behu. keden malka barich lehahu diyyukena, bechol birkan devarich leavraham, kad aved nafshan dechayyayvayya.

Vekudesha berich hu ramiz led mashreyayn illain, venatlin lehahu diyyukena, veazlin immeh, veihu al le almin genizin, dela zache behu bar nash achara, bar innun genizin leinun deavde nafshehon dechayyayvayya. veilmale havo yade bene nasha, kamma toalta uzechu (garme letzadikaya) vezakkan beginayyhu kad zachu lehon. havo azlu avatrayyhu, veradfe lon keman deradif batar chayyin.

Miskena zache livne nasha bechamma tavan, bechamma genizin illain, velav ihu keman dezakke bechayyayvayya. ma ben hay lehay. ella man deishtaddal batar miskena, ihu ashlim chayyin lenafsheh, vegarim leh leitkayyeyma, vezache begineh, lechamma tavan lehahu alma. uman deishtaddal batar chayyayvayya, ihu ashlim yattir. avid lesitra achara deelohim acherim deitkafya, vela shalta, veabar leh mishshultanuteh. avid deistallak kudesha berich hu al kurese yekareh. avid lehahu chayyayva, nafsha achara. zakkaa chulakeh.

Gavvna achara, deitchaze vela itchaze, beshaata dematan yisrael likdusha desidra, keden hay gavvna deganiz, venafik, begin dehay ihu kedushata deka mekaddeshe yisrael yattir al malache illae, deinnun chaverim bahadayyhu. vehay gavvna nahir veitchaze beshaata deyisrael mekaddeshe kedushata da, (nusach acher deha mesayyeyme yisrael ad lo yashgichun vechulei) ad dimsayyeyme yisrael, begin dela yishgechun malachim illain, veyanishu lon leella, vela yekatregun alayyhu.

Keden karoza nafik veamar, illain vetattain atzitu, man ihu gas rucha bemille deorayyta, man ihu dechol milloy begin lemigba bemille deorayyta begin detanenan, devar nash bae lemeheve shafil behay alma bemille deorayyta, deha let gevahu beorayyta, ella bealma deate.

Bikdushata da, baenan leistammera, uleagneza lah benana, begin denitkaddesh go kedusha beresha uvesofa. yattir meinnun kedushan deamre bahadan malache illae. kedusha deanan mekaddeshe bishvacha deanan meshabbechan lemalache illae, uvegin shevacha da, shavkin lan lemeal go tare illae, veal da anan amrin kedusha da
756: Belashon hakkodesh, veshavkin lan birchimu, lemeal tarin dilella, miggo deanan meshabbechin lon besidura dilhon. (saadaylan) uvegin kach, anan natlin kedushan yattir, vealin tarin illain.

Vei tema rammauta hi. lav hachi. ella malache illae innun kaddishin yattir minan, veinnun natle kedushata yattir, veilmale deanan natlin umashchin alan kedushan illen, la nechul lemeheve chaverim bahadayyhu, vikara dekudesha berich hu la yishtelim ella vetatta bezimna chada. veal da anan mishtaddelin lemeheve immehon chaverim, vistallak yekara dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta bezimna chada.

Kedusha di besofa, ihi targum, kema deokimna. veda afillu (132 amud bet) yachid yachil lomar lah, innun mille detargum. aval millin delashon hakkodesh dikdushsha, lav innun ella baasara, begin delashon hakkodesh shechinta mitchabbera bahadeh. uvechol kedusha dishchinta atya, lav ihu ella baasara. dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:32) venikdashti betoch bene yisrael vegomer, bene yisrael innun lashon hakkodesh vadday, vela shear ammin deit lon lishan achara.

Vei tema, ha kedushata dekaddish, deihu targum, amay lav ihu beyachid. ta chaze, kedushata da, lav ihu kishar kedushan deinnun meshalshin. aval kedushata da, ihi salka bechol sitrin, leella vetatta uvechol sitre mehemnuta, vetavra manulin vegushepankan defarzela, ukelippin bishin, (sefer acher veda ihu shevacha deistallak beh yikkare dekudesha berich hu yattir meshabbacha achara. veistallaku da yattir mikkolla, may tama, begin deihu garim laatarepaya sitra achara uleistalleka) leistalleka yekara dekudesha berich hu al kolla, vaanan baenan lememar lah belishana desitra achara, uleatava bechela takkif, amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach, begin deyitbar chela desitra achara, vistallak kudesha berich hu bikareh al kolla. vechad ittebar bikdushata da chela desitra achara, kudesha berich hu istallak bikareh, veadkar livnoy, veadkar lishmeh. uvegin dekudesha berich hu istallak bikareh bikdushata da, lav ihi ella baasara.

Uvelishana da, al karcheh desitra achara itkafya, veittevar cheleh, veistallak yekara dekudesha berich hu, vetavar manulin vegushepankan veshalshelan takkifin, ukelippin bishin, veidkar kudesha berich hu lishmeh velivnoy. zakkain innun amma kaddisha dekudesha berich hu yahav lan orayyta kaddisha, lemizke bah lealma deate.

Amar rabbi shimon lechavrayyay, zakkain attun lealma deate, vechevan desharenan millin dechitra demalchuta illaa emma ana beginayychu (nusach acher bagevaveyykav) vekudesha berich hu yahiv lechon agra behahu alma. vehahu haval defumayychu, yistallak leella, keillu attun mitarin millin illen.

Patach veamar (Shemot 25:3) vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam zahav vachesef unechoshet. hay kera ihu lesitra illaa, veihu lesitra tattaa. ihu lesitra illaa, besitra dikdushsha. veihu lesitra tattaa, besitra achara. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, share lemivre missitra dechaspa, deihu yemina, begin dehahu kaspa hava milleella. uveovada demashkena, deihu kegavvna dileh, share missitra dismala, ulevatar missitra dimina. begin demashkena missitra dismala hava, veal da share hacha missitra dismala, vehatam missitra dimina, vezot hatteruma vegomer.

Uchetiv (Tehillim 55:18) erev vavoker vetzohorayim vegomer, hay kera ukemuha veittemar, aval hacha iddan idanin hu ditzlota dechol yoma. vechavrayyay ittearu behane telat zimnin. erev, da hi aspakalarya dela nahara. vavoker, da hi aspakalarya denahara. vetzohorayim, (lav hay atar deikre choshech, ella atar ihu dekayyeyma ben hay lehay, aval zimna ditzlota demincha) atar deitkere choshech ihu, deachid baerev, vekayyeyma da im da.
Uma deittemar tzohorayim, deihu tukepa deshimsha. lishana maalya nakat. vehachi ihu archa, levar nash ucham,
757: Karan leh chivvavr, velishana maalya nakat, ulezimnin lechivvavr karan leh ucham, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:1) ki ishsha kushit lakach (Amos 9:7) halo chivne chushiyyim attem li vegomer.

Erev da, tzelota dearvit. uvegin diverev da itarav beh sitra achara, dechashich nehoreh, veshalta belelya, shauu leh reshut, velet leh zeman kavua, (141 amud alef, 162 amud alef) emurin ufedarin mitakkelin behay zimna, umikkan ittezanu kamma chavile tehirin, denafkin veshaltin belelya.
Vei tema, i hachi, ha taninan, dechol innun mare sitra achara deruach misova, la shalte (140 amud bet) beara kaddisha, veha mitare lon yisrael behay, veasir leitteara lon lesharya al ara kaddisha.

Ella belelya, hahu tenana salik, vela salik kegavvna dekarbena achara, dehava salik tenana beorach meshar, vehacha hava salik hahu tenana lechad nukeba detzafon, detamman kol madorin deruchin bishin, vechevan dehahu tenana salik (141 amud alef, 242 amud bet) veakim orach lehahu sitra kullehu havo mitzanin vekayymin vealin beduchetayyhu, vela havo nafkin veshaltin bealma.

Chad memana kayyeyma lehahu sitra, al hahu nukeba detzafon, bechol innun chavile tehirin, sangirya shemeh, uveshaata dehahu tenana akim archeh vesalik, hay memana veshittin elef ribbo mashreyayn acharanin, kullehu mitattedan lekabbela leh, uleattezna minneh, vekayymin behahu nukeba, vealin bechad pitcha deikre keri, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:28) veim telchu immi keri vegomer, uchetiv, vehalachti immachem bachamat keri, behahu rugeza denafik mippitcha dekeri.

Veillen innun dimshattete belelya, (264 amud alef, 267 amud alef) uveshaata denishmatin nafkin lesalleka, leitchazaa leella, innun nafkin, umekatregan lon, vela yachlin lesalleka uleitchazaa leella, bar innun chaside kaddishin elyonim, deinnun bakin rekiim vaavirim vesallekin. veillen chavile tehirin nafkin, umodiin millin kedivin livne nasha, veitchazzeyayn lon bediyyukenin acharanin, vechayychan behu, ad deoshdin zara, veikrun marehon dekeri, begin deinnun denafkin mippitcha dekeri, garme lon.
Uveshaata demitakkele emurin ufedarin, hahu tenana have ravve lon, vezan lon, kefum yekara dilhon, hachi mezona dilhon, ma deitchaze lon. uvehay, la nafkan, vela meshattete beara kaddisha.

Erev: kema deat amer, (Shemot 12:38) vegam erev rav ala ittam, dechol innun chavile tehirin, innun mitarve beshuletanu delelya. veal da la shavyuha chova litzlota dearvit, delet man deyachil leatkena lah keyaakov, deihu hava mari (medakke) mashkena, umetakken leh kedka yeot.

Veaf al gav deihu reshu, tzelota da ihu leaggana alan miggo pachad ballelot, miggo pachad dechamma sitrin degehinnam, deha behahi shaata tarde lechayyayvayya baggehinnam, al chad teren mibbimama. ubbegin kach, mekaddeme yisrael lememar vehu rachum, deihu begin pachad degehinnam. uveshabbat dela ishtechach pachad dina degehinnam, vela dina achara, asir leatara leh, deitchaze deha let reshu leshabbat leabera dina mealma.

Vefachad dekitruga denishmatin, kad baan lesalleka leella, leitchazzaa kame marehon. ubbegin kach anan makdimim, shomer et ammo yisrael laad amen. pachad dechamma mazzikin vekitrugin demishtakkeche belelya, veit lon reshu lenazzeka, leman denafik mittera beteh levar, ubbegin kach anan makdimim, ushemor tzetenu uvoenu.

Veal kol da, miggo dechilu dechol da, anan mafkidinan gufin ruchin venishmatin, lemalchuta illaa, di shuletanu decholla bidaha. veal da tzelota dearvit, bechol lelya velelya. hasheta dekarbenin umadbechan la ishtechachu, anan avdenan kol tikkunin deanan avdin al raza dena.
Befalgu lelya, kad ruach tzafon ittear, batash bechol innun madorin deruchin bishin, vetavar (chad tinara takkifa) (97 amud alef) sitra achara, veal veshat leella vetatta, vechol innun
758: Chavile tehirin ayylin leduchetayyhu, veittebar chelayyhu vela shaltin. ucheden kudesha berich hu al leishtashea im tzaddikayya beginta deeden, veha ittemar.

Kad ate tzafra, nehora dishraga deshalta belelya, itgeniz mikkame nehora dimama, keden boker shalta, veitabbar shuletanu deerev, (ucheden) hay boker, ihu boker deor kadmaa, hay boker, ashlim tivu lealmin kullehu. minneh ittezanu illain vetattain. hay ashke leginta. hay ihu netiru dechol alma.

Hacha raza leyade middin, (57 amud alef) man devae lemefak learcha, yekum benagha, veyishgach beistakkeluta lefum shaata, listar (112 amud bet) mizrach, veyecheme kechezu deatvavn devatshe birkia, da salik veda nachit. veillen innun netzitzu deatvavn, deitberun behu shemayya veara.

I ihu yada beraza deinnun atvavn, deinnun raza dishma kaddisha, dearbein uteren atvavn, veyidkar lon kadka chazi, biruta delibba. yechome go nehiru denagha dirkia shit yodin, telat listar yemina, utelat listar semala. utelat vavin, desallekin venachtin venatztze birkia. veinnun atvavn devirkat kohanim, ucheden yitzle tzeloteh, veyippuk learcha, vadday shechinta akdimat immeh, zakkaa chulakeh.

Kad ate hay boker, ammuda chad naitz bistar darom, lego metichu dirkia, deal gabbe ginta. bar mehahu ammuda, deihu (184 amud bet) naitz beemtzau deginta. veammuda da, ihu nahir (vaychi 219 amud alef) binhiru ditlat gavvnin, merukkama deargevavna. behahu ammuda, kayyeyma anfa chada, behahu anfa, itattadu telat tzipporin, mitarin tziftzufa leshabbecha.

Patach chad veamar, (Tehillim 113:2) haleluyah halelu avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. patach tinyayna veamar, yehi shem Adonai mevorach meatta vead olam. patach telitaa veamar, mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo mehullal shem Adonai. keden karoza kadim vekare itatadu kaddishe elyonin, innun dimshabbechan lemarehon, ittakkanu bishvacha dimama. keden itparshun yemama min lelya. zakkaa chulakeh, man dekam betzafra, miggo tushebachta deorayyta, delae belelya. behahu zimna tzelota detzafra.

Ketiv, (Yeshayahu 21:12) amar shomer ata voker vegam layla im tivayun beayu shuvu etayu, hay kera ukemuha leh, al galut deyisrael, deyatve go bene seir, veyisrael amre lekudesha berich hu, shomer, ma millayla, ma tehe alan min galuta da, dedamme lachashocha delelya. ma ketiv, amar shomer, da kudesha berich hu, ata voker, kevar nehirna lechu begaluta demitzrayim, veassikna lechu vekarivit yatchon lefulechani, veorayyta yahavit lechon, begin detizkun lechayye alma. shevaktun orayyti, vegam layla, ailna lechu begaluta (sefer acher devavel, veassikna lechu. shevaktun orayyti kemillekaddemin, ailna lechu begaluta) kemillekaddemin. im tivayun beayu kema deat amer, (yeshaya la) dirshu meal sefer Adonai ukerau, vetamman tishkechun bema talya galuta dilchon, ugeula dilchon, vechad tivayun bah, hi tema vetachriz kamayychu. shuvu etayu. shuvu bitshuva shelemata, umiyyad etayu veikrivu legabbay. (nusach acher uveraza dehay kera)

Uvehay kera ketiv, massa duma. veraza da, beshit dargin dinvua (bachamishsha archin) ittemar linvie. bemachaze. bachazon. bechizzayon. bechazut. bedavar. bemash. vechullehu chamishsha kullehu keman dechame batar kotala, hahu nehiru dinhora. uminnehon, keman dechame nehora deshimsha miggo ashashita. aval massa, have, kad mate hahu nehora betorach saggi veitrach milloy aloy, dela yachil leitgalyay leh, kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 11:11) lasum et massa kol haam hazze alay. ubbegin kach, massa.

Vehacha massa duma, torach saggia, dela yachil leitgalyay veihu nevua bilchishu, vekayyeyma bilchishu. elay kore misseir hacha la itgalya man amar elay kore misseir. i kudesha berich hu, i nevia mehemana. aval nevua da vadday kayyeyma bilchishu, go raza dimhemnuta illaa, umiggo raza setimaa, nevia mehemana amar, dilleh hava kara kala beraza dimhemnuta, veamar elay kore misseir.
759: Kema deat amer, (Devarim 33:2) vezarach misseir lamo. vela ketiv vezarach leseir, begin deraza dimhemnuta hachi ihu, dargin miggo dargin, illen penimain meillen, kelifa go kelifa, umocha go mocha.

Veha okimna, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:4) vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon, ha darga chad. anan gadol, ha darga achara. veesh mitlakkachat, ha darga telitaa. venoga lo saviv, ha darga reviaa. ulevatar umittochah keen hachashmal. ulevatar umittochah demut arba chayyot ha dargin go middargin (nusach acher dargin).

Uf hacha, kad itgalleyay kudesha berich hu leyisrael, la itgalleyay ella miggo dargin illen. missinay ba, darga dehava temira yattir, ulevatar itzterich leitgalya. veamar vezarach misseir, ha darga achara, deihu beitgalleyay yattir, kelifa desharya al gav mocha. ulevatar hofia mehar paran, ha darga achara. ulevatar veata merivvot kodesh, da shevacha decholla, deaf al gav deitgalyay mikkol illen dargin, mehahu atar dehu ikara decholla, share leitgallaa minneh. mean atar ihu. merivvot kodesh ihu, innun dargin illain leella, (leella) uf hacha elay kore misseir, mehahu darga dekaamaran, deitdabbak leella.

Shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. shomer da metatron, (shomer yisrael) uchetiv, (Mishlei 27:18) veshomer adonav yechubbad, veda raza deshalta belelya. ma millayla shomer ma millel, ma ben hay lehay. ella, kolla chad, aval bechulaka da, shalta sitra achara. uvechulaka da, la shalta kelal. lel, itzterich lintura, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:42) lel (37 amud bet) shimmurim hu, veal da chaser Adonai, veda ihu kad al lelya, ad deitpelag. mippalgu lelya ulehala, shalta layla baAdonai dichtiv vayhi bachatzi hallayla. hu hallayla hazze. (Tehillim 139:12) velayla kayyom yair vegomer. uvegin kach, shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel.

Amar shomer. ashkachna besifra deadam, ma ben vayyomer leamar. vayyomer leella, veamar letatta, veel moshe amar. man (164 amud alef) amar, amar shomer, da metatron. ata boker, da tzelota deshacharit deihu shultanu dimama, hahu deshalit al lelya. vei tema deihu ate bilchodoy, veitperash dechar minnukeva, ha ketiv vegam layla, tarvavyyhu kachada, vela (7 amud alef) mitparshin da min da lealmin. vekala da kare bemillin illen, ata voker vegam layla tarvavyyhu zeminin legabbayychu.

Mikkan ulehala im tivayun beayu. im tivun bautechon bitzllo kamme malka kaddisha, beayu, tzallu uveu bautechon, vetuvu legabbe marechon. etayu, keman dezammin lekabbela livnoy, ulerachama alayyhu. uf hachi kudesha berich hu, boker vegam layla, kara veamar etayu. zakkaa amma kaddisha, demarehon bae alon, vekara lon lekarva lon legabbeh.

Keden amma kaddisha, baan leitchabbera, uleaala beve kenishta. vechol man deakdim bekadmita, itchabbar bishchinta bechibbura chada. ta chazi, hahu kadmaa deishtechach beve kenishta, (veorich beve kenishta) zakkaa chulakeh, deihu kayyeyma bedarga detzaddik bahade shechinta. veda ihu raza (Mishlei 8:17) umeshacharay yimtzaunni. da salik bisliku illaa. vei tema, ha tanenan beshaata dekudesha berich hu ate leve kenishta, vela ashkach tamman asra, miyyad koes. veat amart hahu chad deakdim, itchabbar bishchinta, vekayyeyma bedarga detzaddik.

Ella, (351 156 amud alef) lemalka deshadar lechol bene mata, deyishtakkechun immeh beyom pelan, bedoch pelan. ad dahavo mezammene garmayyhu innun bene mata, akdim chad veata lehahu atar. ben kach uven kach ata malka, ashkach lehahu bar nash deakdim tamman, amar leh, pelan beni mata an innun. amar leh, mari, ana akdimna minnayyhu, veha innun atan avatray lefikkuda demalka. keden, tav beene malka, veyativ tamman vahadeh, veishtae immeh, veitavid rechima demalka. ben kach
